guide: [[@2611.29613|Weight Coding]] 重点看被训练压小的 LayerNorm 增益：Pinterest 生产召回模型里，光把它们重置回 1 就值 10 个点，**线上模型的权重本身可能就有现成的改进空间**。[[@2611.28645|PROSPER]] 说明 LLM 换进 SPLADE 收益小，是因为扩展词压过了品牌、型号这类字面词。[[@2611.28555|abc]] 的精确倒排索引在 top-1000 上比 Seismic 更快，“学习型稀疏检索只能用近似索引”在召回深度大时不成立。[[@2611.31185|CO-GRAFT]] 的结论是只看最终答案的奖励几乎不改进 query。

[[@2611.30243|搜索 Agent 纠错评测]]发现，把答案页排到第一位，Agent 常常还是不点开；直接把关键段落放进上下文，准确率高出 51 个点，**瓶颈在读没读到，不在搜没搜到**。[[@2611.33210|生物医学自适应检索]]里，置信度在专科难题上的 AUROC 只有 0.506，接近随机，而检索恰好在这些题上最有用，作者建议默认总是检索。[[@2611.30819|Ask Again]] 测到同一个问题问两次，生成式引擎排第一的条目有 32% 的概率不同，品牌可见度监测常用的 7–8 次采样不够。[[@2611.29948|TriVS]] 把磁盘向量检索拆成内存路由、内存蒸馏、按向量读盘三步，吞吐是 PipeANN 的 3.42 倍；[[@2611.29252|Zarc]] 在 4 张 H100 上对十亿向量做精确 kNN，一万个 query 用时 1.1 秒。

funnel: 当日公布新论文（cs.IR / CL / AI / LG / DB 全量 + cs.CV 短语过滤）

papers.title: Weight Coding: Evolving Web-Scale Recommenders through Direct Weight Edits with LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 不训练、直接改权重：Pinterest 召回 Recall@10 涨 15 个点
papers.summary_zh: 让 LLM Agent 直接编辑生产推荐模型权重，Pinterest 图搜召回模型 Recall@10 最多涨 15 个点。
papers.abstract_zh: 网络规模的推荐模型主要通过重训练或微调来演进。我们提出==weight coding==，一种通过直接、可执行的权重编辑来演进模型的方法。大语言模型（LLM）智能体检查模型结构和参数，提出假设，并依据评测反馈实施编辑。这一循环从局部修改推进到定向搜索与组合，使被编辑的组件相互适配。缓存引擎支持无需反向传播的快速前向评测。在 Pinterest 的 147M 参数图像搜索双塔召回模型上，weight coding 只用少量编辑、约为一次完整后训练微调 1/4 的 GPU 时长，就将生产模型在留出数据上的 recall@10 最多提升 15.0 个百分点（相对 +24%），而一次常规上线通常只提升约 1%。在保留周围已训练模型、将 13.6M 参数的整个交互模块随机重新初始化后，只搜索 2,448 个混合与归一化参数，仍比生产模型高 9.8 个点。离线收益覆盖整个漏斗，包括稠密召回、生成式召回和排序，可学习参数最多达 1.37B，且每种架构的编辑各不相同。==引导编辑==（steering）可对新鲜度、商品等细分人群上的模型表现做显式控制。Weight coding 无需改动线上服务，**线上 A/B 测试中，来自被编辑召回源的人均保存数提升 8.4% 至 10.7%**，与目标业务指标一致。我们的结果表明，weight coding 是真实网络规模生产系统中用于模型开发和行为控制的实用工具，并有望扩展到整个漏斗的预训练和后训练阶段。
papers.abstract_en: Web-scale recommender models evolve primarily through retraining or fine-tuning. We propose \emph{weight coding}, a methodology for model evolution through direct, executable weight edits. A large language model (LLM) agent inspects model structure and parameters, formulates hypotheses, and implements edits using evaluation feedback. The loop progresses from localized changes to targeted searches and composition, allowing edited components to adapt to one another. A cached engine enables rapid forward evaluation without backpropagation. On Pinterest's 147M-parameter Image Search two-tower retriever, weight coding improves held-out recall@10 of production model by up to 15.0 percentage points (+24\% relative) with few edits in about 1/4 GPU hours of a full post-training finetune, while a common launch only improves around 1\%. After reinitializing the entire 13.6M-parameter interaction module randomly while retaining the surrounding trained model, searching 2,448 mixing and normalization parameters yields 9.8 points above production. Offline gains span the full funnel including dense retrieval, generative retrieval and ranking, with up to 1.37B learnable parameters and different edits for each architecture. Steering edits provide explicit control of model performance over segments like freshness and product. Weight coding requires no serving change and online A/B tests increase saves per user from the edited retrieval source by 8.4\% to 10.7\%, aligned with the target business objectives. Our results establish weight coding as a practical and useful tool for model development and and behavioral control in a real web-scale production system, with potential to extend to both pre-training and post-training stages across the funnel.
analysis: 不反传梯度，只让 LLM 智能体直接改已训练好的权重，Pinterest 图搜 147M 参数双塔召回模型的 recall@10 涨了 15.0 个百分点（相对 +24%）。作者称之为 ==weight coding==。单是把交互模块 [[dhen|DHEN]] 里训练后偏小的 LayerNorm 增益（γ≈0.36、0.23）重置回 1、再调低共享偏置，就拿到 +10.1 点。
流程是==扫描==各模块的缩放、重置、剪枝等编辑，==过滤==掉换一天就反号的效果，再编辑或用 [[evolution-strategy|进化策略]] 搜索，最后在从不参与迭代的留出日上验证。缓存引擎只重算被改模块的下游。4 轮循环的总耗时约为一次 140 GPU 小时微调的 24.6%。
两条反直觉的发现：删掉 DHEN 全部四个分支，召回反而涨 6.1 点，**训练好的分支净贡献为负**；把 13.6M 参数的 DHEN 整个随机重置、只搜 2,448 个参数，仍比生产高 9.8 点。开发日变化超过 1 点的编辑里，23% 换一天就反号。
保留意见：**缺少用梯度只训练同样 2,128 个参数的 baseline**，分不清收益来自智能体还是这几个位置本身；按全部互动优化的 6 个线上版本里 5 个保存数下降，换成保存目标才拿到 +8.4%～10.7%。做双塔召回的团队可以先对自家模型的 LayerNorm 增益和共享偏置做一次重置扫描；作者也试过去掉权重衰减重训，增益回到 1 附近但召回反降 3.5 点，所以重训替代不了这一步。
star_reasons: Pinterest 生产模型，线上 A/B 验证
不反传梯度只改权重，Recall@10 +15 点
随机重置交互模块仍超生产 9.8 点
揭示 LayerNorm 增益被训练压小

figures.caption_zh: 直接编辑的效果：开发日上每个编辑对查询塔召回的影响、==LayerNorm 增益==缩放、分支与偏置缩放，以及混合搜索前后浅层 token 的占比。
(a) 智能体驱动的循环：对训练好或随机初始化的权重直接编辑、验证；(b) 在 Pinterest 图搜召回模型上，逐轮编辑后各项指标的相对变化。
Pinterest 图搜双塔召回模型：两塔都从跨场景基础模型微调而来；右边是查询塔里的 ==DHEN== 交互模块，标出了本文的编辑位置。
搜索与组合：随机重置后靠搜索把召回找回来，以及从训练好和随机两种起点出发的搜索轨迹。
换到其他模型和目标上的编辑：PinRec 插值、排序模型专家缩放，以及按新鲜度、商品定向的召回调控。

papers.title: PROSPER: LLMs as Sparse Retrievers for First-Stage Product Search
papers.title_zh: 给 LLM 稀疏召回补回品牌词，淘天线上净 GMV +1.6%
papers.affiliation: 中国科学院计算技术研究所、中国科学院大学、阿姆斯特丹大学、阿里巴巴淘天集团
papers.summary_zh: 用LLM做商品搜索的稀疏检索器，并通过残差网络保留品牌、型号等字面信号。
papers.abstract_zh: 商品搜索是大型电商平台的关键组成部分，其中第一阶段召回既要做到高召回率，又要保证线上部署的效率。稀疏检索因可解释、易部署，在这一场景中仍有吸引力，但它面临严重的词汇不匹配问题，对短 query 和商品标题尤其如此。大语言模型（LLM）语义能力强，但直接把它用于商品搜索的稀疏检索会带来新的挑战：（i）语义扩展可能扭曲品牌名、型号等关键的字面信号；（ii）在 LLM 带来的高维词表空间中，很难学到有意义的稀疏表示。为此我们提出 PROSPER，一个把 LLM 用作商品搜索稀疏检索器、并显式保持词汇保真度的框架。PROSPER 包含两部分：（i）==literal residual network==，通过残差补偿机制强化权重偏低的字面词，缓解词汇扩展幻觉；（ii）==lexical focusing window==，利用 top-k 选择实现快速的早期稀疏化，并提供有效的训练初始化。大量离线评测和大规模线上 A/B 测试表明，PROSPER **稳定优于现有稀疏检索器，并为工业级混合检索系统带来收入增长**。
papers.abstract_en: Product search is a crucial component of large-scale e-commerce platforms, where first-stage retrieval should achieve high recall while ensuring efficient online deployment. Sparse retrieval remains attractive for this setting due to its interpretability and deployability, yet it suffers from severe vocabulary mismatch challenges, especially for short queries and product titles. Large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic capabilities, but directly applying them to sparse retrieval in product search introduces new challenges: (i) semantic expansion may distort critical literal signals such as brand names and model identifiers; and (ii) learning meaningful sparse representations is difficult in the high-dimensional vocabulary space induced by LLMs.To address these challenges, we propose PROSPER, a framework that uses LLMs as sparse retrievers for product search while explicitly preserving lexical fidelity. PROSPER combines (i) a literal residual network that alleviates lexical expansion hallucination by reinforcing underweighted literal terms through a residual compensation mechanism; and (ii) a lexical focusing window that uses top-k selection for rapid early sparsification and effective training initialization. Extensive offline evaluations and large-scale online A/B tests demonstrate that PROSPER consistently improves over existing sparse retrievers, and provides revenue gains for industrial hybrid retrieval systems.
analysis: 直接把 [[splade|SPLADE]] 的 BERT 换成 Qwen2.5-3B，Multi-CPR 电商测试集的 Hit@1000 只从 89.6% 升到 91.3%；PROSPER 加上两个部件后到 93.9%，略高于稠密模型 BGE-base 的 93.7%，在约 1% 流量上跑了一个月 A/B，直接引导的净 GMV 涨 1.60%。论文追问的是 LLM 语义更强、换进稀疏检索却收益很小的原因，答案是**扩展词压过了字面词**：“爱立舍机油滤芯”里品牌“爱立舍”权重偏低，“老捷豹副水箱”被扩展出“狸”“豺”“虎”等动物词。

==literal residual network（LRN）== 专门给 query 或商品标题里原样出现的词（字面词）补权重：用一个全连接层从最后一个 token 的隐状态算出向量 w′，每个字面词加上 max(w)−w′，扩展词不动。==lexical focusing window（LFW）== 在训练早期只保留权重最高的 k 个词（query 取 256、商品取 512），非零维数降到 k 以下后自动失效，之后交给 [[flops-regularization|FLOPS 正则]]继续压稀疏。打分时只对 query 向量做 ℓ2 归一化。

去掉 LFW 后 Hit@1000 从 93.9 掉到 87.2、Hit@1 从 25.3 掉到 13.3，**训练起步的稀疏化比补字面词影响更大**：Qwen2.5 词表超过 15 万维，而 query 平均只有 6 个词。归一化同样敏感，query 和商品两侧都做 ℓ2 归一化时 Hit@1000 也降到 87.2。骨干从 1.5B 换到 7B 没有明显提升，所以线上用 1.5B。线上 8000 万商品的索引是 93 GB（稠密通道 152 GB），匹配延迟约 20 ms，是稠密通道的两倍。

保留意见：作者自己测的 Qwen3-Embedding-4B 稠密检索 Hit@1000 是 94.9，BGE 在 Hit@1 和 MRR@10 上也更高，**PROSPER 并不比稠密检索更准**，线上收益来自在多路召回里多加一路；线上的 A/B 也没有拆出 LRN 和 LFW 各自的贡献，“只有 PROSPER 召回到的商品”这项分析没给数字。对已有稠密召回、想加一路可解释稀疏通道的电商搜索团队，论文给出的配置可以直接照搬：1.5B 骨干、query 端归一化、上线时 query 只保留权重最高的 16 个词。
star_reasons: 1% 流量一个月 A/B，净 GMV +1.60%
消融指出早期 top-k 稀疏化最关键
稀疏召回 Hit@1000 略高于 BGE-base 稠密模型
部署配置完整，可直接照搬

figures.caption_zh: PROSPER 的模型结构：query 和商品各自编码后，==LRN== 模块单独给原样出现的字面词补权重。
训练流程：==LFW== 在训练早期只保留权重最高的 k 个词，之后交给 FLOPS 正则继续压稀疏。
PROSPER 在淘天工业级搜索引擎里的位置：作为多路召回中新增的一路稀疏通道。

papers.title: The abc index: Exact Retrieval for Learned Sparse Representations
papers.title_zh: 学习型稀疏检索用精确索引，比 Qdrant 最多快 84 倍
papers.summary_zh: 仅用经典IR技术构建精确索引，在学习型稀疏检索上比多数精确和近似索引更快。
papers.abstract_zh: 在学习型稀疏检索（LSR）中，query 含有几十个带学习权重的词项，一般认为经典的动态剪枝在这类 query 上会失效，而 Seismic、HNSW 等近似索引比精确索引更快。我们用 abc 质疑这一看法：abc 是一个只用标准 IR 技术构建的==精确索引==，用到逐词（TAAT）评估、Block-Max MaxScore、binary packing 和 doc-id 重排。这些技术以新的方式组合，并针对现代 CPU 做了工程优化。在用四种 LSR 模型编码的 MS MARCO 上，abc 在每个 k 值下都是最快的精确索引：**比 Qdrant 的精确搜索快 6.5–84 倍，比 Lucene 快 13–55 倍，比 BMP 快 2.9–18 倍且索引小 5–7 倍**。与近似索引相比，它的空间占用少 1.5–3.6 倍，延迟随 k 增长得慢得多：k=10 时近似索引最多快 4.3 倍，但到 k=1000 时 abc 反超，最多快 7.4 倍。精确检索还带来一个额外好处：没有需要调的参数。
papers.abstract_en: In learned sparse retrieval (LSR), queries have tens of terms with learned weights, on which classic dynamic pruning is believed to fail, and approximate indexes such as Seismic and HNSW are considered faster than exact ones. We challenge this view with abc, an exact index built only from standard IR techniques: term-at-a-time (TAAT) evaluation, Block-Max MaxScore, binary packing and doc-id reordering. They are combined in a new design and engineered for modern CPUs. On MS MARCO encoded with four LSR models, the abc index is the fastest exact index at every k: 6.5-84x faster than the exact search of Qdrant, 13-55x faster than that of Lucene, and 2.9-18x faster than BMP with an index 5-7x smaller. Against approximate indexes, it takes 1.5-3.6x less space, and its latency grows much more slowly with k: they are up to 4.3x faster at k=10, but at k=1000 it overtakes them, by up to 7.4x. Exactness comes with an extra benefit: there are no parameters to tune.
analysis: 在 MS MARCO 的四种稀疏编码上，只用经典倒排技术拼出的精确索引 abc-bmms 比 Qdrant 快 6.5–84 倍，取 k=1000 时还比近似索引 Seismic 快 1.7–7.4 倍。[[learned-sparse-retrieval|学习型稀疏检索（LSR）]]的 query 有几十个学出来的权重，一般认为剪枝在这里失效、精确检索注定慢。论文的回答是：**慢在实现，不在算法**。

核心是==硬窗口==：doc-id 空间切成固定对齐、每块 8192 个文档的块，所有词共用，累加器只占 32 KiB，放得进 L1 缓存；倒排每条只存 16 位块内偏移，偏移就是累加器下标，打分只剩一次乘加。在这个[[term-at-a-time|逐词（TAAT）]]循环上，每块再分 8 个子块各存 1 字节最大值，块内跑 [[maxscore|Block-Max MaxScore]] 剪枝，剩下的几十个候选用二分查找补分。

同一个剪枝算法在两处结果相反：abc-bmms 在 k=10 时比不剪枝的 abc 快 2.9–4.1 倍，Lucene 的 Block-Max MaxScore 却比它自己的穷举慢，最多慢 2.7 倍，差别在于 abc 的子块上界跨词对齐、可以直接相加。论文还发现几种号称精确的索引并不精确：BMP、SP 把 query 权重量化到 32 级，召回上限只有 0.966–0.978；SparseUp 的长 query 让 16 位分数溢出，SP 的 recall@10 只有 0.22。

保留意见：实验只有 880 万篇的 MS MARCO v1、单线程、一台 L1 为 48 KiB 的 CPU，块宽也是按这台机器挑的，**没测更大语料和多线程吞吐**，代码录用后才公开；k=10 时 Seismic 和 HNSW 仍快 1.1–4.3 倍。召回要取 top-1000 交给精排、或者要算精确 ground truth（比暴力扫描快 27–52 倍）的团队，值得用它替换 Qdrant 或 Lucene 的稀疏检索；只取 top-10 的在线召回，近似索引仍更快。
star_reasons: 挑战LSR必须用近似索引的共识
四种编码、九个基线统一对比
揭示多个精确索引实际不精确
无参数，十几秒建完索引

figures.caption_zh: 一个词的倒排在 abc 里的内存布局：doc-id 空间按 8192 切块，用位向量记哪些块有这个词；稀疏块存 16 位偏移和 8 位权重，稠密块直接存 8192 个权重。
==Block-Max MaxScore== 用的子块上界：每块再切成 8 个子块，各存这个词在子块里的最大权重。

papers.title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
papers.title_zh: RL 让搜索 Agent 变强，但写 query 的贡献不到 15%
papers.summary_zh: 用 Shapley 值把搜索 agent 的 RL 收益拆分到推理、决策、query 生成和答案抽取四个角色。
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）可使 LLM 搜索 agent 的精确匹配（EM）得分比 RL 前的初始化最多高出 32 个点，但整体准确率的提升并不能说明训练中哪些功能能力得到改进或相互作用。我们提出 CO-GRAFT，一个与奖励无关的==干预式归因框架==：RL 训练后的 agent 与其 RL 前的初始化在带实时检索的闭环执行中共同生成同一条轨迹。每个策略控制四个功能角色中互不重叠的子集：中间推理、搜索或回答的决策、搜索 query 生成、最终答案抽取。无需修改权重或重新训练，评估全部 2^4=16 种角色分配即构成一个合作博弈，其 Shapley 值把总 RL 收益分解到各角色，Möbius 交互项则区分单角色的独立改进与多角色耦合。我们把 CO-GRAFT 用于 Qwen2.5 和 Llama-3.2 上的 Search-R1 agent（涵盖两种规模、base 与 instruction-tuned 初始化、GRPO 与 PPO 优化器、NQ 与 HotpotQA 数据集），结果表明 **query 生成带来的收益从未超过总收益的 15%**；收益主要取决于 RL 前的答案有效性、搜索保留率、模型规模和固定的任务级搜索预算：在更大或答案格式良好的 checkpoint 中，贡献从推理转向答案抽取，而较小的 base 模型依赖推理与决策的耦合。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.
analysis: 在 Search-R1 类搜索 Agent 上，RL 带来的 EM（exact match，答案与标准答案完全一致的比例）提升最高 31.6 个点，但**“写搜索 query”这一步在所有模型上都只分到不超过 15% 的收益**。论文追问的是 RL 之后 Agent 到底哪一步变好了。答案是收益主要落在推理和写最终答案上，分配比例取决于模型在 RL 前能不能输出格式合法的答案，以及 RL 后还搜不搜。

CO-GRAFT 把轨迹切成四个==角色==：推理 R（`<think>` 里的文本）、决策 D（下一步发 `<search>` 还是 `<answer>`）、查询 Q（搜索词）、答案 A（填进 `<answer>` 标签的最终答案）。RL 后的模型和 RL 前的初始化在同一条轨迹里接力生成，各管一部分角色，检索实时进行，即[[policy-grafting|策略嫁接]]。16 种分配各跑 1,000 道题，用 [[shapley-value|Shapley 值]] 把总收益分到四个角色，用 [[mobius-interaction|Möbius 交互项]] 区分单角色收益和多角色耦合。模型覆盖 Qwen2.5-3B/7B、Llama-3.2-1B/3B 的 base 与 instruct 版，数据集为 NQ 和 HotpotQA。

Qwen2.5-3B base 在 NQ 上 70% 的收益来自推理；换成 7B base，推理降到 40%，答案升到 38%。答案份额很多是格式：改用宽松指标（子串匹配、token F1）后，**Qwen2.5-7B base 的答案份额从 38% 跌到 −5%**。决策学到的也不是“证据够了就停”：把 D 换成固定搜索次数（Qwen2.5-3B PPO 在 NQ 上搜 1 次、HotpotQA 上搜 2 次），EM 与完整 RL Agent 相差不到 1 个点。Llama-3.2-3B instruct 在 RL 后完全不搜了（每题 1.4 次降到 0），收益只有 3.2 个点。

保留意见：模型最大只到 7B，每个数据集只评 1,000 题；固定搜索次数和冻结检索这两组对照只在两对 Qwen2.5 PPO 模型上做，最优搜索次数还是在评测集上挑的。另外 RL 前基线的格式合法率很低（Qwen2.5-3B base 在 NQ 上只有 53%），总收益里本来就有一块是学格式。对训练搜索 Agent 的人来说，**只用结果奖励（只看最终答案对错）不会让 query 变好**，我觉得想提升检索能力得给 query 和停止决策单独设奖励；报告结果时也应同时给出宽松指标，免得把格式收益算成能力收益。
star_reasons: 拆解搜索 Agent 的 RL 收益来源
16 种角色组合在实时检索下实测
覆盖两个模型家族、两种优化器
宽松指标下答案收益消失，格式被算成能力

figures.caption_zh: CO-GRAFT 框架：(a) 一条轨迹按推理、决策、写 query、写答案四个角色切开；(b) RL 前后两个模型分角色接力生成；(c) 16 种分配下的 EM 和各角色的 Shapley 份额。

papers.title: CocoonBench: Can Multilingual Search Agents Escape Language Information Cocoons?
papers.title_zh: CocoonBench：多语言搜索智能体能否逃离语言信息茧房？
papers.summary_zh: 基于 Wikidata 构建的多语言搜索智能体基准，最强模型准确率不足 70%。
papers.abstract_zh: 多语言搜索智能体可以访问全球 Web，却可能困在证据不足的单一语言环境中，我们把这种失败称为语言信息茧房。然而，现有搜索基准大多只在单一语言（尤其是英语）内运行，忽略了跨语言的实体联系。我们提出 CocoonBench，用于评估多语言搜索智能体能否逃离这种语言信息茧房。CocoonBench 从冻结的 Wikidata 衍生图中挖掘以答案为中心的关系路径，并选出各自必要、合起来能唯一确定答案的线索集合。它使用各语言的实体名称，记录每个任务的最小语言覆盖，去除直接标识符，并把每个任务渲染成三种语言的对应提示，同时附带构造证书和来源信息。在 10 个最先进模型上，==CocoonBench== 的平均准确率从 33.8%（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）到 69.7%（Claude-Opus-4.8）不等，**最强系统也低于 70%**。同样的构造证书支持路径对齐的轨迹分析，可用来诊断模型在语言路由、证据路径恢复和答案使用上的失败。结果表明，逃离语言茧房需要的不只是切换语言：成功的跨语言搜索既要覆盖正确的语言，又要把跨语言找到的证据连接起来。
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual search agents can access the global Web, yet may remain trapped in a language environment with insufficient evidence; we refer to this failure as a language information cocoon. However, existing search benchmarks largely operate within a single language, especially English, overlooking entity connections across multiple languages. We introduce CocoonBench, a benchmark that evaluates whether multilingual search agents can escape such language information cocoons. CocoonBench mines answer-centered relational paths from a frozen Wikidata-derived graph and selects clue sets that are individually necessary and jointly identify a unique answer. Using language-specific entity names, it records each task's minimum language cover, removes direct identifiers, and renders each task as matched prompts in three languages together with its construction certificate and provenance. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, mean accuracy on CocoonBench ranges from 33.8% (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) to 69.7% (Claude-Opus-4.8), leaving even the strongest system below 70%. The same construction certificates support path-aligned trajectory analysis, enabling diagnosis of model failures in language routing, evidence-path recovery, and answer use. The result shows that escaping a language cocoon requires more than switching languages: successful cross-lingual search depends on both covering the correct languages and connecting the evidence found across them.

papers.title: Look Before You Leap: Re-Architecting Disk-Resident Vector Search with TriVS
papers.title_zh: 三思而行：用TriVS重构磁盘驻留向量检索
papers.summary_zh: TriVS把磁盘向量检索拆为粗逼近、内存蒸馏、精确收敛三阶段，吞吐达PipeANN的3.42倍。
papers.abstract_zh: 磁盘驻留的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）使向量检索可扩展到超出DRAM的规模，但即便使用高速SSD和精巧的I/O执行，最先进的系统仍受I/O瓶颈限制。为理解该瓶颈，我们做了以I/O为中心的分析，把每次查询拆成定位查询邻近区域的逼近（approach）阶段和确定最终top-k的收敛（converge）阶段。分析揭示了互补的I/O权衡：基于聚类的搜索通过内存路由避免了逼近阶段的I/O，但在收敛时要读取粗粒度的完整簇；基于图的搜索全程使用细粒度的向量级I/O，收敛高效，但逼近阶段的I/O不可避免。为结合两种粒度的I/O优势，我们提出TriVS，一种把磁盘驻留向量检索重构为三部曲的新范式：粗粒度逼近、渐进蒸馏、精确收敛。其关键创新有两部分。第一，它把逼近和收敛阶段从单一搜索粒度中解耦，用基于聚类的搜索避免逼近阶段I/O，用向量级I/O实现高效收敛。第二，为衔接两种粒度，它在原有两阶段之间引入新的内存内==蒸馏（distill）阶段==，在访问磁盘前借助紧凑的量化向量，把路由到的簇逐步缩减为向量级候选短名单。此外，更粗的聚类缩小了质心路由索引，使TriVS可以把已有内存重新分配给蒸馏阶段，而无需扩大内存预算。我们在涵盖多种向量类型和规模的五个数据集上评测，结果显示在Recall@10=0.9时，TriVS平均**吞吐为PipeANN的3.42倍，延迟降低51.2%，磁盘I/O减少63.7%**，同时使用更少的内存和存储。
papers.abstract_en: Disk-resident approximate nearest-neighbor search (ANNS) scales vector search beyond DRAM, yet state-of-the-art systems remain I/O-bound, even with fast SSDs and sophisticated I/O execution. To understand this bottleneck, we conduct an I/O-centric analysis that breaks each query down into an approach phase that locates a query-near region and a converge phase that resolves the final top-k. This analysis reveals complementary I/O tradeoffs: cluster-based search circumvents approach-phase I/O through in-memory routing but reads coarse-grained, full clusters during convergence, whereas graph-based search employs fine-grained, vector-level I/O throughout, enabling efficient convergence at the cost of inevitable I/O during the approach phase. To combine the complementary I/O benefits of the two granularities, we present TriVS, a new paradigm that re-architects disk-resident vector search as a trilogy: approach coarsely, distill progressively, and converge exactly. Its key innovations come in two parts. First, it decouples the approach and converge phases from a single search granularity, employing cluster-based search to avoid approach-phase I/O and leveraging vector-level I/O for efficient convergence. Second, to bridge the two granularities, it introduces a new in-memory distill phase between the original two, progressively reducing routed clusters to a vector-level shortlist using compact quantized vectors before disk access. Moreover, coarser clustering shrinks the centroid-routing index, allowing TriVS to reallocate existing memory to distillation rather than expand its memory budget. Our evaluation on five datasets spanning diverse vector types and scales shows that, at Recall@10=0.9, TriVS achieves on average 3.42X PipeANN's throughput, 51.2% lower latency, and 63.7% less disk I/O, while using less memory and storage than PipeANN.

papers.title: Zarc: Exact Nearest Neighbors over a Billion Vectors in Seconds
papers.title_zh: Zarc：数秒内完成十亿向量的精确最近邻搜索
papers.summary_zh: 多GPU上基于半精度证明与主机内存回取实现十亿向量精确kNN
papers.abstract_zh: 精确 k 近邻向量搜索处于机器学习系统的关键路径上，从最新 LLM 的稀疏注意力，到长上下文记忆和训练数据去重。穷举式 GPU 搜索要为每个查询扫描整个数据集，而近似索引返回的邻居并不精确。近期方法借助廉价的半精度证明跳过几乎所有太远的向量，但只适用于一块 GPU 容纳整个数据集的情形。我们的思路是只把这些证明的短行保留在 GPU 内存，其余少量需要的完整向量从主机内存取回。我们的系统 ==Zarc== 在数据更新下精确回答欧氏、余弦、内积以及带过滤的查询。在四块 H100 上，它在 **1.1 秒内完成对十亿向量的 10,000 次精确查询，而此前需要五分钟**。在十一个开源 LLM 上，它检索精确 top-10 注意力键的速度比穷举搜索快 2.2 到 13.1 倍。在百万 token 的稀疏注意力中，它比使用 FlashInfer 的 bf16 选择快 3.1 倍，而后者在多数查询上无法命中精确 top-64。
papers.abstract_en: Exact k-nearest-neighbor vector search lies on the critical path of machine learning systems, from sparse attention in the latest large language models (LLMs) to long-context memories and training-data deduplication. Exhaustive GPU search scans the whole dataset for every query, while approximate indexes return inexact neighbors. Recent methods skip almost every vector with a cheap half-precision proof that it lies too far away, but only on one GPU that holds the whole dataset. Our insight is to keep only the short rows of these proofs in GPU memory and to fetch the few remaining full vectors from host memory. Our system, Zarc, answers Euclidean, cosine, inner-product, and filtered queries exactly under updates. On four H100 GPUs, it answers 10,000 exact queries over one billion vectors in 1.1 seconds instead of five minutes. On eleven open LLMs, it retrieves the exact top-10 attention keys 2.2x to 13.1x faster than exhaustive search. In sparse attention over one million tokens, it runs 3.1x faster than bf16 selection with FlashInfer, which misses the exact top-64 for most queries.

papers.title: S$^2$LMR: Supervised Sequential Long-Context Multi-Step Retriever
papers.title_zh: S²LMR：有监督的序列式长上下文多步检索器
papers.summary_zh: 用单个共享Transformer建模多步检索，监督训练即可逼近SOTA。
papers.abstract_zh: 长上下文上的多步检索是检索增强生成的关键能力，但现有强方法训练成本高且复杂。有监督检索器更简单便宜，在这一设定下却明显落后。我们指出，这一差距并非源于有监督训练本身，而是训练与推理之间的三处错位：训练负例过于简单、检索前缀含噪声、打分与位置无关。基于这一分析，我们提出 ==S²LMR==，一种简单有效的有监督序列式检索器，把多步检索建模为由单个共享Transformer编码的==显式文本状态==的演化。在上下文长度从4K到10M token的长上下文推理、多跳问答和大海捞针基准上，S²LMR 达到与最先进方法相当的性能，**明显优于此前的有监督检索器**。值得一提的是，对于最长10M token的上下文，它在单张A6000上只需约2小时训练，并且在大范围超参数设置下保持稳健。项目主页：https://fujump.github.io/s2lmr_page/
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step retrieval over long contexts is a key capability for retrieval-augmented generation, but strong existing approaches are costly and complex to train. Supervised retrievers are far simpler and cheaper, yet they fall well behind in this setting. We show that this gap stems not from supervised training itself, but from three misalignments between training and inference: easy training negatives, noisy retrieval prefixes, and position-agnostic scoring. Guided by this analysis, we introduce S$^2$LMR, a simple yet effective supervised sequential retriever that models multi-step retrieval as the evolution of an explicit textual state encoded by a single shared Transformer. On long-context reasoning, multi-hop QA, and needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks with context lengths ranging from 4K to 10M tokens, S$^2$LMR achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods, substantially outperforming prior supervised retrievers. Notably, it requires only $\sim$2 hours of training on a single A6000 for contexts of up to 10M tokens, while remaining robust across a wide range of hyperparameter settings.

papers.title: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
papers.title_zh: TowerBridge：通过权重空间编程弥合双编码器的模态鸿沟
papers.summary_zh: 用 LLM agent 发现并蒸馏出闭式权重修正，在 21 个 CLIP 检查点上提升图文检索。
papers.abstract_zh: CLIP 式双编码器通过两个独立的塔把图像和文本映射到共享的 embedding 空间，两种模态在其中占据不同区域，之间存在==模态鸿沟==。当错误匹配（hard negative）排在正确匹配之前时检索就会失败，而模态鸿沟通常被认为是原因。然而，事后消除这一鸿沟会使我们测试的每个 CLIP 检查点的检索效果下降。我们提出一个成对统计量，用来找出两个塔在 hard negative 上比在匹配对上更一致的方向。适度衰减这些方向可以提升检索，同时基本保留鸿沟。我们通过==权重空间编程==得到这一修正：在该统计量的引导下，一个 LLM agent 检查两个塔并写出无需反向传播的闭式权重编辑。agent 可以自由编辑任意组件，在全部 13 个 CLIP 检查点上提升了 COCO 测试集检索，其中 12 个编辑的是输出投影。我们把它反复出现的修正蒸馏并精炼为 TowerBridge，这是一个由 hard-negative margin 的一阶分析推出的闭式方案。它只需 25,000 个标注对、几秒即可算出，无需针对模型调参，也不改变架构和推理成本。在全部 21 个被评估的 CLIP 检查点（含 8 个 agent 未见过的）上，TowerBridge 平均将 COCO 测试集检索提升 **16.8 RSUM**、Flickr30k 测试集检索提升 **6.6**，而 ImageNet zero-shot 准确率的下降不超过 0.5 个点。它还在全部 21 个检查点上降低了 hubness，并在来自其他系列的 5 个双编码器中的 4 个上提升了检索效果。
papers.abstract_en: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, a closed-form recipe motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin. Computed in seconds from 25,000 labelled pairs, it requires no model-specific tuning and leaves the architecture and inference cost unchanged. TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval by 16.8 RSUM and Flickr30k test retrieval by 6.6 on average across all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints, including 8 unseen by the agent, while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to 0.5 points. It also reduces hubness on all 21 checkpoints and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.

papers.title: Query Obfuscation with Embedding-Optimized Noise (EON): A Representational Blindspot in Agentic Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 基于 Embedding 优化噪声的 Query 混淆（EON）：Agentic 检索中的表征盲区
papers.summary_zh: 无语义噪声可保留 query 的检索结果并绕过输入护栏，暴露双编码器的 BLINDSPOT。
papers.abstract_zh: 在现代 agentic 与语义检索系统中，稠密 embedding 模型越来越多地决定一个 query 应检索哪个意图、工具、文档、记忆或图像。我们发现这条流水线中存在一种表征失效模式：有意义的 query 可以被肉眼可见的无语义内容替换，同时保留大部分检索结果，即使候选库对优化器是隐藏的。我们提出==Embedding-Optimized Noise（EON）==，它只用自然 query 的表征构造，不需要候选 embedding、相关性标签、排序、检索反馈或护栏决策。尽管目标与语料无关，EON 仍然经常能在多个稠密 embedding 家族上保留意图与工具路由、benchmark 文档搜索、情景式 agent 记忆检索和跨模态搜索。关键在于，这种脱节带来严重的安全隐患：对恶意 query，**EON 能稳定绕过拦截自然 query 的输入护栏**，使涉及安全敏感内容的检索在未被察觉时执行。随后我们通过 embedding 空间的几何性质刻画了 query 级表征匹配为何能稳定保持对优化时未见候选的检索结果。这些发现共同揭示了双编码器上的一个基本现象，我们称之为 ==BLINDSPOT==：系统对无语义伪影视而不见，却仍可靠地检索出真实且有后果的内容。
papers.abstract_en: In modern agentic and semantic retrieval systems, dense embedding models increasingly determine which intent, tool, document, memory, or image to retrieve for a query. We identify a representational failure mode in this pipeline: a meaningful query can be replaced by visibly nonsemantic content while preserving much of its retrieval outcome, even when the candidate bank is hidden from the optimizer. We introduce Embedding-Optimized Noise (EON), constructed using only the natural query representation, without access to candidate embeddings, relevance labels, rankings, retrieval feedback, or guardrail decisions. Despite this corpus-blind objective, EONs frequently preserve intent and tool routing, benchmark document search, episodic agent-memory retrieval, and cross-modal search across multiple dense embedding families. Crucially, this disconnect carries serious security implications: for malicious queries, an EON can reliably evade input guardrails that block the natural query, executing the intended safety-sensitive retrieval undetected. Through the geometry of the embedding space, we then characterize how query-level representation matching can reliably maintain subsequent retrieval outcomes over candidates unseen during optimization. Together, these findings expose a fundamental phenomenon across dual encoders that we call BLINDSPOT, where systems remain operationally blind to nonsemantic artifacts while reliably retrieving real, consequential content.

papers.title: From Head to Tail: LLM-Augmented Sequential Recommendation and Trade-off Optimization
papers.title_zh: 从头部到长尾：LLM 增强的序列推荐与权衡优化
papers.summary_zh: 用 LLM 为不同流行度分组的物品生成合成交互，在约束整体 NDCG 下优化长尾效果。
papers.abstract_zh: 推荐系统存在流行度偏差，常常对交互稀疏的长尾和冷启动物品服务不足。我们提出一种分组数据增强方法，利用 LLM 生成合成交互，并将其表述为约束优化问题：在整体 NDCG@20 下降不超过可接受阈值的前提下，最大化分组的 NDCG@20 和覆盖率。物品按交互频次划分，为每个分组寻找最优增强策略。我们进一步研究了多组同时增强的组合方式，发现各组的最优策略并不能简单叠加。我们还对基于 LLM 的增强本身做了消融，比较了 LLM 规模以及 token 限制下的增强配置，发现增强质量随上下文丰富度提高，但成本也相应上升。在 SASRec 上的实验表明方法有效：在工业数据集上，极端长尾和普通长尾物品的分组 NDCG@20 分别提升**超过 100% 和 60%**，在 MovieLens-32M 上分别提升 **40% 和 25%**，同时提高了覆盖率，整体指标没有明显下降。
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems exhibit popularity bias, often under-serving long-tail and cold-start items with sparse interaction data. We propose a group-specific data augmentation approach that leverages LLMs to generate synthetic interactions, formulated as a constrained optimization problem, maximizing group-specific NDCG@20 and coverage while bounding overall NDCG@20 degradation within an acceptable threshold. Items are partitioned by interaction frequency to find the optimal augmentation strategy for each group. We further study combining the augmentation across groups simultaneously and find that while individual optimal strategies navigate the multi-group augmentation design, they are not simply additive. We further ablate on the LLM-based augmentation itself, comparing LLM scales, augmentation configuration under token constraints, finding that augmentation quality scales with contextual richness, albeit at a proportionally higher cost. Experiments with SASRec demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, achieving over 100% and 60% improvement in group-specific NDCG@20 for extreme and regular long-tail items, respectively, on our industrial dataset, and 40%, 25% for MovieLens-32M, while increasing their coverage without significant overall degradation.

papers.title: Ask Again: Answer-List Instability in Generative Engines
papers.title_zh: 再问一次：生成式引擎中答案列表的不稳定性
papers.summary_zh: 6 万条回答显示生成式搜索引擎对同一问题的答案列表和首位项经常变化，品牌可见度测量需量化不确定性。
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式搜索引擎中的可见度，由哪些实体出现在回答中以及排在什么位置来衡量。对同一个问题问两次，答案列表可能不同：顺序变了，甚至条目都变了。在 60,000 条回答中，我们发现同一提示的回答有 **32% 的概率给出不同的第一项**，即便两条回答包含相同条目，对谁排第一也会有分歧。首位本身就是一个独立的测量目标。运行七八次后会出现"明显领先者"，这也是品牌和来源监测推荐的预算，但"接近的领先者"只有约一半的情况下能被识别出来；运行 25 次后，接近的领先者也仅有 60% 能被识别。引擎之间的差异大于同一引擎内部的差异；开放式提示的差距是确定性提示的两倍以上。所观察到的搜索查询和引用站点只能解释很小一部分分歧。可见度测量应当对每个引擎报告哪些条目出现、各自排第一的频率，并分别给出不确定性量化。
papers.abstract_en: Visibility in generative search engines is measured by which entities appear in responses, and in what order. Ask an engine the same question twice and the answer list can change: a different ordering, or different items altogether. Across 60,000 responses, we find that answers to the same prompt name a different first item 32% of the time, and even two answers with the same items disagree on which comes first. The first position is a measurement target of its own. A "clear leader" emerges after seven or eight runs, which are the budgets recommended for brand and source monitoring, but a "close leader" only about half the time. After 25 runs, a close leader is identified only 60% of the time. Variability between engines is larger than within the same engine. For open-ended prompts, the gap is more than double that for determinate ones. Search queries and cited sites observed leave most of the disagreement unexplained. Visibility measurement should report, for each engine, which items appear and how often each comes first, each with its own quantification of uncertainty.

papers.title: MTL-MHOL: Predicting Online Conversions under Delayed Feedback and Data Sparsity
papers.title_zh: MTL-MHOL：在延迟反馈与数据稀疏下预测线上转化
papers.summary_zh: 用时间分桶处理延迟反馈、辅助任务缓解稀疏的 CVR 预测框架。
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出与模型无关的多任务学习多头在线学习（MTL-MHOL）框架，用于转化率（CVR）预测。现有方法通常把延迟反馈、数据稀疏等 CVR 预测的关键难题孤立处理，或缺乏灵活性和实用性。MTL-MHOL 采用==时间分桶==处理延迟反馈，并结合辅助任务的多任务学习缓解数据稀疏。我们在某私营公司的专有数据集和 Criteo 公开数据集上评估该框架。MTL-MHOL 在负对数似然（NLL）和相对交叉熵（RCE）上持平或优于所有基准模型，使用 MLP 骨干时能正确捕捉数据中的时间趋势，使用 DeepFM 骨干时也保持强劲表现。特别地，MTL-MHOL 与先进的延迟反馈方法 FSIW 表现相当，**在 RCE 上比全空间方法 ESMM 高 21.5%，相比最佳经典基准最高提升 81%**。
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes the model-agnostic Multi-Task Learning Multi-Head Online Learning (MTL-MHOL) framework for conversion rate (CVR) prediction. Existing approaches typically address key challenges in CVR prediction, such as delayed feedback and data sparsity, in isolation or lack flexibility and practical applicability. MTL-MHOL adopts a time bucketing approach to account for delayed feedback and combines it with multi-task learning of an auxiliary task to mitigate data sparsity. We evaluate the framework on proprietary datasets from a private company and on a public dataset from Criteo. MTL-MHOL matches or outperforms all benchmark models in terms of Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) and Relative Cross Entropy (RCE), and it correctly captures temporal trends in the data using an MLP backbone, while maintaining strong performance with a DeepFM backbone. In particular, MTL-MHOL matches the performance of the advanced delayed-feedback method FSIW, outperforms the entire-space approach ESMM by 21.5% in RCE, and achieves up to 81% lift in RCE compared to the best-performing classical benchmark.

papers.title: Can Search Agents Correct Their Own Errors? Evaluating Retrieval, Evidence Delivery, and Answer Completion
papers.title_zh: 搜索 Agent 能纠正自己的错误吗？检索、证据递送与答案补全的评测
papers.summary_zh: 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上干预证据来源，区分搜索 Agent 的检索、递送、纠错与补全失败。
papers.abstract_zh: 搜索 Agent 可能因为没找到正确来源、忽略了相关段落，或在拿到证据后没有修正并给出答案，而让早先的错误一直留着。我们在 BrowseComp-Plus 上评估这几种可能：把各模型自己的错误闭卷答案放回对话重放，并干预到达模型的证据。在覆盖四个开源权重 checkpoint、709 个问题、26,665 个测试条件的给定证据实验中，即使上下文里有含答案的段落，一个自信的 assistant 先验也让 Nemotron 的配对准确率下降 **16.1 个百分点**。当用户坚持该先验时，Nemotron 的准确率下降 32.9 个点，gpt-oss 下降 12.6 个点。在 gpt-oss 因此答错的回答中，弃答比重复先验更常见。在使用 Qwen3.5 和 Nemotron 的单独搜索干预中，把 gold 页面排在第一位，往往仍然没有打开决定性来源。与中性递送相比，在上下文中递送决定性段落使 Qwen3.5 的准确率提高 **51.0 个百分点**，Nemotron 提高 22.4 个点。即便段落已在上下文中，Nemotron 仍有 19/51 个 episode 耗尽搜索预算而没有返回答案。这些测试区分了检索、段落递送、纠错和答案补全四类失败，让系统构建者能检验哪些改动能解决反复出现的错误。
papers.abstract_en: A search agent can leave an earlier error unresolved by missing the right source, overlooking a relevant passage, or failing to revise and deliver the answer after receiving the evidence. We evaluate these possibilities on BrowseComp-Plus by replaying each model's own wrong closed-book answer in conversation and intervening on what evidence reaches the model. In a supplied-evidence study spanning four open-weight checkpoints, 709 questions and 26,665 test conditions, a confident assistant prior reduced Nemotron's paired accuracy by 16.1 percentage points despite answer-bearing passages in context. When the user insisted on the prior, accuracy fell by 32.9 points for Nemotron and 12.6 for gpt-oss. Among gpt-oss responses that lost correctness in that condition, abstention was more common than repeating the prior. In separate search interventions with Qwen3.5 and Nemotron, placing a gold page first often left the decisive source unopened. Delivering a decisive passage in context improved accuracy over neutral delivery by 51.0 percentage points for Qwen3.5 and 22.4 for Nemotron. Even with the passage in context, Nemotron exhausted its search budget and returned no answer in 19 of 51 episodes. The tests distinguish failures of retrieval, passage delivery, correction and answer completion, giving system builders a way to test which changes resolve a recurring error.

papers.title: Pixel as the Common Language: Unified Multimodal Embedding via Visual Rendering
papers.title_zh: 以像素为通用语言：基于视觉渲染的统一多模态 Embedding
papers.summary_zh: RenderEmbed 先把各类输入渲染成图像再由 VLM 编码，统一多模态检索表示。
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态 embedding 模型把异构输入映射到共享表示空间，但纯文本、纯图像和组合输入仍以不同格式呈现，并在模型中走不同路径。这种割裂使各异构任务无法联合优化同一条端到端编码过程，限制了跨输入配置的监督迁移。为此我们提出“编码前统一”，并以 RenderEmbed 实现。该框架用 ==Visual Substrate Rendering== 把异构输入转换成统一的视觉底板，再交给 VLM 编码。在得到的视觉 token 上，Progressive Hierarchical Anchor Encoding 通过交错的可学习 anchor 并跨层融合其状态，生成紧凑的检索表示，同时保留整体上下文和细粒度线索。Interventional Rendering Learning 通过互补的语义干预与渲染干预，训练这些表示对内容变化保持敏感、对渲染变化保持稳定。在涵盖多种检索任务的 MMEB 和 ViDoRe v2 上，RenderEmbed 在同等规模下优于此前的 SOTA 模型，并表现出较强的域外泛化。**与 MetaEmbed 相比，MMEB 总体 Precision@1 提高 1.7 个点，域外任务提高 2.1 个点。** 迁移与扩展分析进一步表明，共享的视觉通路能更有效地从异构监督中学习。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal embedding models map heterogeneous inputs into a shared representation space, yet text-only, image-only, and composed inputs are still presented in distinct formats and follow different routes through the model. This fragmentation prevents heterogeneous tasks from jointly optimizing the same end-to-end encoding process, limiting supervision transfer across input configurations. To address this issue, we propose unification before encoding and instantiate this paradigm in RenderEmbed. The framework uses Visual Substrate Rendering to convert heterogeneous inputs into a common visual substrate for encoding with a VLM. From the resulting visual tokens, Progressive Hierarchical Anchor Encoding produces compact retrieval representations by interleaving learnable anchors and fusing their states across layers, retaining broad context and fine-grained cues. Interventional Rendering Learning trains these representations to remain sensitive to content changes and stable across rendering variations through complementary semantic and rendering interventions. Extensive experiments on MMEB and ViDoRe v2, spanning diverse retrieval tasks, show that RenderEmbed outperforms prior state-of-the-art models at the same scale and exhibits strong out-of-domain generalization. Compared with MetaEmbed, RenderEmbed improves MMEB Overall Precision@1 by 1.7 points, with a larger 2.1-point gain on out-of-domain tasks. Transfer and scaling analyses further show that a shared visual pathway enables more effective learning from heterogeneous supervision.

papers.title: CompareDR: Benchmarking Deep Research Reports from Individual Quality to Comparative Merit
papers.title_zh: CompareDR:从单篇质量到比较价值的深度研究报告基准
papers.summary_zh: 用逐项审计加两两比较评测深度研究报告,与人类偏好一致率86.25%
papers.abstract_zh: 深度研究系统可能针对同一query生成证据、分析和结论各不相同的报告。读者要决定采信哪些发现,需要知道每份报告满足任务要求的程度,以及哪些差异对答案有影响。单份报告的分数可以概括质量,却无法指出是哪些贡献让一份报告比另一份更有用。我们提出==CompareDR==,一个结合任务级逐项审计与基于准则的两两比较的基准。我们用关联段落的报告表示来定位相关差异,并用选择性证据验证来核查可能影响判断的论断。基准包含来自三个现有基准的40个中英文任务、九个系统的360份报告、1,099条人工审核的评测准则,以及对80对报告盲比得到的人类偏好。**混合评测器与其中69对人类偏好一致(86.25%,Cohen's κ=0.746)**。该基准既支持对研究系统的比较,也支持检查这些判断背后的证据与分析。
papers.abstract_en: Deep research systems can produce reports with different evidence, analyses, and conclusions for the same query. A reader deciding which findings to rely on needs to know how well each report meets the task requirements and which differences matter to the answer. A score for a single report can summarize its quality, but it does not identify which contributions make one report more useful than another. We introduce CompareDR, a benchmark that combines task-specific pointwise audits with guideline-based pairwise comparisons. We use passage-linked report representations to locate relevant differences and selective evidence verification to check claims that could affect the judgment. The benchmark comprises 40 Chinese and English tasks from three existing benchmarks, 360 reports from nine systems, 1,099 human-reviewed evaluation criteria, and human preferences elicited through blinded comparisons of 80 report pairs. The hybrid evaluator matches 69 of these 80 preferences (86.25%, Cohen's $κ=0.746$). The benchmark supports both comparisons of research systems and examination of the evidence and analyses behind those judgments.

papers.title: GraphSeer: Multimodal Knowledge Graph Relational Image Retrieval with MLLMs
papers.title_zh: GraphSeer:基于MLLM的多模态知识图谱关系图像检索
papers.summary_zh: 给定照片和关系描述,用MLLM检索图谱中相关实体,MRR提升12.5-70.0%
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态知识图谱(MMKG)存储带照片和名称的实体,并用事实将它们相连。MMKG方法预测已知实体ID之间的链接,而从CLIP到MLLM embedder的图像检索器返回与查询照片相似或符合其描述的实体。对于一张新照片,常见的问题是图谱中哪个实体与图中所示实体相关,例如照片中球员所在的球队或地标所在的城市,这两类方法都无法回答。我们将其称为==知识图谱关系图像检索(KRIR)==:给定照片和自然语言关系,检索相关的MMKG实体,该实体很少与照片相似,无论图中所示实体在图谱内(已知)还是不在(未见)。我们基于YAGO、Wikidata和真实场景OVEN照片构建了三个基准。该任务隐含两跳:识别照片对应哪个图谱实体,以及回忆它与什么相连。==GraphSeer==在同一个多模态LLM内连接两者:将照片链接到图谱,读取最佳匹配的事实,并用模型即将说出答案时的隐状态做检索。未见实体自身没有事实,但每个候选答案都有,因此listwise验证器从图的另一端读取信息:在一次前向中依据候选的事实和照片对top候选重排,其中事实比照片重要得多。使用Qwen3.5-27B时,**在已知实体上,GraphSeer的MRR比用同样数据和预算微调的MLLM embedder提升24.2-70.0%**;当它同时融合并验证embedder的候选时,未见实体上MRR提升12.5-25.6%,在已知实体上还超过了直接给定真实实体ID的KG补全模型。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) store entities with photos and names and link them by facts. MMKG methods predict links between known entity IDs, and image retrievers, from CLIP to MLLM embedders, return entities that look like a query photo or match its description. Neither answers a common question about a new photo: which graph entity is related to the one shown, such as the team of a pictured player or the city of a landmark. We call this knowledge graph relational image retrieval (KRIR): given a photo and a natural-language relation, retrieve the related MMKG entity, which rarely resembles the photo, whether the depicted entity is in the graph (known) or not (unseen). We build three benchmarks from YAGO, Wikidata and in-the-wild OVEN photos. The task hides two hops: recognising which graph entity is shown, and recalling what it is connected to. GraphSeer bridges them inside one multimodal LLM: it links the photo to the graph, reads the facts of the best match, and retrieves with the hidden state at which the model is about to say the answer. An unseen entity has no facts of its own, but every candidate answer does, so a listwise verifier reads the other end of the graph: it re-ranks the top candidates by their facts and photos in one forward pass, and the facts matter far more than the photos. With Qwen3.5-27B, GraphSeer improves MRR on known entities by 24.2-70.0% over an MLLM embedder fine-tuned on the same data with the same budget. When it also fuses and verifies the embedder's candidates, it improves MRR on unseen entities by 12.5-25.6%, and on known entities it beats KG-completion models given the ground-truth entity ID.

papers.title: SJG: A Skyline Joint Graph for Multi-Component Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.title_zh: SJG:面向多分量近似最近邻搜索的天际线联合图
papers.summary_zh: 用天际线联合图支持查询权重未知的多分量ANN搜索,吞吐最高27.9倍
papers.abstract_zh: 基于图的索引通过连接相似对象,实现大规模的近似最近邻搜索。在商品检索和租房列表搜索等应用中,相似度取决于多个分量,且各分量的相对重要性随query而变。难点在于索引构建时就要选择邻居,而决定哪些对象最近的query权重尚未可知。直接的做法是为每个分量单独建索引,但合并各自的搜索结果可能漏掉加权距离下的最近邻。联合图允许搜索跨分量跟随链接,有助于避免这类遗漏,但在各分量内分别选邻居会留下冗余边,而保持各分量层次结构同步又限制了并行构建。为此我们提出==Skyline Joint Graph(SJG)==。虽然query权重会改变候选邻居的排序,但它们之间的支配关系与权重无关。SJG利用这一性质,跨分量汇集候选并为每个节点保留==Skyline==,从而在不同query权重下实现高效的近似最近邻搜索,同时支持并行建图。在六个真实数据集上的大量实验表明,**在90% Recall@10下SJG的查询吞吐最高达基线的27.9倍,单线程建索引最高加速201倍**,索引空间比最小的基线索引至少少36%。
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based indexes enable efficient approximate nearest neighbor search at scale by linking similar objects. In applications such as product retrieval and rental listing search, similarity depends on several components whose relative importance varies across queries. The challenge is that the index must select neighbors during construction, but the query weights that determine which objects are closest are not yet known. A straightforward approach is to index each component separately. However, merging the results of these searches can miss the nearest neighbor under the weighted distance. A joint graph allows a search to follow links across components, helping to avoid such misses, but selecting neighbors separately within each component can leave redundant edges, and keeping component hierarchies synchronized limits parallel construction. To address these limitations, we propose the Skyline Joint Graph (SJG). Although query weights can change the ranking of candidate neighbors, the dominance relation among them is independent of those weights. SJG exploits this property by pooling candidates across components and retaining the Skyline for each node, thereby enabling efficient approximate nearest neighbor search under different query weights while supporting parallel graph construction. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets demonstrate that SJG achieves up to $27.9\times$ the query throughput of baseline methods at 90% Recall@10, while accelerating single-threaded index construction by up to $201\times$. Its index requires at least 36% less space than the smallest baseline index.

papers.title: SupportChain: Trace-Calibrated Aggregation of Quote-Grounded Reasoning Chains for Multi-Hop RAG with Small Readers
papers.title_zh: SupportChain：面向小型推理模型多跳RAG的、基于引文推理链的轨迹校准聚合
papers.summary_zh: 多跳RAG中拆分子问题、绑定引文并按支持度聚合多次执行，无需建索引。
papers.abstract_zh: 多跳检索增强问答的强结果通常来自由70B及以上模型读取的图索引，而构建这类索引需要让大语言模型遍历整个语料。我们提出SupportChain：把问题拆成多跳，将每一跳的答案绑定到从检索段落中引用的一句话上，根据每次执行自身的轨迹估计其可靠性，并按答案的==支持度==（一致执行的汇总可靠性）合并多次执行，支持度足够高时即停止。在HippoRAG 2的协议下，使用9B阅读器，SupportChain在MuSiQue上达到**63.0 F1，高于此前最好的59.2（使用20B阅读器）**。在相同的阅读器和embedder下，它在全部五个数据集上都显著优于HippoRAG 2，最多高17.2 F1，且不需要构建索引。按支持度合并在五个数据集中的三个上显著优于多数投票和让阅读器自选候选，在另外两个上与二者持平。可靠性模型只需100个带答案的训练问题。
papers.abstract_en: Strong results in multi-hop retrieval-augmented question answering come from graph indexes read by models of 70B parameters or more, and building such an index calls a large language model over the whole corpus. We present SupportChain, which splits a question into hops, binds each hop's answer to a sentence quoted from a retrieved passage, estimates how reliable each execution is from its own trace, and merges several executions by the support of their answers, the pooled reliability of the executions that agree, stopping once support is high enough. With a 9B reader under the HippoRAG~2 protocol, SupportChain reaches 63.0 F1 on MuSiQue, above the best earlier result of 59.2, which used a 20B reader. With the same reader and embedder, it is significantly better than HippoRAG~2 on all five datasets, by up to 17.2 F1, and it builds no index. Merging by support is significantly better than majority voting, and than letting the reader choose among the candidates, on three of the five datasets and level with both on the other two. The reliability model needs only 100 answered training questions.

papers.title: Beyond Relevance: An Empirical Study of Multimodal LLMs for Diversity-Aware Recommendation Reranking
papers.title_zh: 超越相关性:多模态 LLM 用于多样性感知推荐重排的实证研究
papers.summary_zh: 免训练的多模态 LLM 重排框架,在 Prime Video 上同时提升相关性与类目多样性。
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型(LLM)已成为有前景的推荐重排器,但现有方法多依赖文本商品描述,且主要关注相关性。在视频流媒体等视觉导向的领域,商品图像提供了互补信号,也可能影响推荐多样性。这引出两个问题:视觉信息何时能提升推荐质量?多模态 LLM(MLLM)能否同时提升相关性与多样性?我们提出一个==免训练、多样性感知的多模态重排框架==,联合利用商品图像、文本元数据和用户交互历史,并在三个公开 Amazon Review 数据集和一个工业级 Amazon Prime Video 数据集上,用开源和闭源 MLLM 做了实证研究。结果显示效果存在明显的领域差异:加入视觉信息后,Prime Video 上 NDCG@5 最高相对提升 121.9%,而在商品推荐数据集上收益有限且不稳定。此外,MLLM 重排在相关性和对类目多样性敏感的排序质量上均优于序列推荐基线,在 Prime Video 上 NDCG@5 最高提升 71.0%,α-NDCG@5 提升 14.1%。这些发现说明视觉信息的价值取决于领域,也表明免训练 MLLM 在兼顾相关性与多样性的推荐重排上有潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising rerankers for recommendation, yet most existing approaches rely on textual item descriptions and primarily focus on relevance. In visually oriented domains such as video streaming, item images provide complementary signals that may also inform recommendation diversity. This raises two questions: when does visual information improve recommendation quality, and can multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) enhance relevance and diversity simultaneously? We investigate these questions through a training-free, diversity-aware multimodal reranking framework that jointly incorporates item images, textual metadata, and user interaction histories. We conduct an empirical study across three public Amazon Review datasets and an industrial Amazon Prime Video dataset, using both open-source and proprietary MLLMs. Our results reveal substantial domain-dependent effects: adding visual information yields up to 121.9% relative improvement in NDCG@5 on Prime Video, while producing limited or inconsistent gains on product recommendation datasets. Furthermore, MLLM-based reranking improves both relevance and category-diversity-sensitive ranking quality over a sequential recommendation baseline, achieving up to 71.0% improvement in NDCG@5 and 14.1% in $α$-NDCG@5 on Prime Video. These findings highlight the conditional value of visual information and the potential of training-free MLLMs for relevance- and diversity-aware recommendation reranking.

papers.title: Confidence-Based Adaptive Retrieval Fails Where It Matters Most: A Paradox in Biomedical Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 基于置信度的自适应检索在最关键处失效：生物医学问答中的悖论
papers.summary_zh: 发现置信度路由在专家级问题上近乎随机，建议默认总是检索
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型越来越多地用于生物医学问答，但看似合理的错误答案在临床场景中仍是安全风险。RAG 可以让回答基于医学文献，而基于置信度的自适应 RAG 只在模型显得不确定时才检索。我们在三个难度递增的生物医学问答基准上评估这种路由策略，并比较了不同参数规模的模型。结果揭示了一个悖论：在标准医学考试题上，置信度校准良好（AUROC 0.78–0.89），但检索增益很小（+2.4% 到 -1.4%）；而在检索最有价值的专家级问题上（+11.2%），**置信度变得近乎随机（AUROC 0.506）**。五种不确定性信号（首 token 概率、margin、熵、基于一致性的采样和口头置信度）都表现出同样的失效模式。五种事后校准修正策略（包括密度比重加权和保序变换）也无法在难题上恢复有用的路由信号（最佳 AUROC 0.507）。跨模型比较显示，更大的参数规模和更高的基础准确率并不能保证在专家领域难度偏移下获得可靠的置信度路由。这些发现质疑了基于置信度的自适应 RAG 的前提：在高风险的生物医学场景中，当目标领域的校准情况未知时，==默认总是检索==比基于置信度的路由更安全、更准确。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for biomedical question answering, but plausible incorrect answers remain a safety risk in clinical settings. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can ground responses in medical literature, while confidence-based adaptive RAG retrieves only when the model appears uncertain. We evaluate this routing strategy on three biomedical QA benchmarks of increasing difficulty and compare models across a broad range of parameter scales. The results reveal a paradox: confidence is well calibrated (AUROC 0.78--0.89) on standard medical exam questions where retrieval adds little value (+2.4\% to -1.4\%), yet becomes \emph{near-random} (AUROC 0.506) on specialist-level questions where retrieval helps most (+11.2\%). Five uncertainty signals---first-token probability, margin, entropy, consistency-based sampling, and verbalized confidence---show the same failure pattern. Five post-hoc calibration correction strategies, including density-ratio reweighting and rank-preserving transformation, do not recover a useful routing signal on hard questions (best AUROC: 0.507). Cross-model comparison shows that larger parameter scale and higher base accuracy do not guarantee reliable confidence-based routing under specialist-domain difficulty shift. These findings challenge the premise of confidence-based adaptive RAG: in high-stakes biomedical settings, defaulting to always-retrieve is safer and more accurate than confidence-based routing when calibration on the target domain is unknown.

papers.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
papers.title_zh: ToolSmith：面向多模态搜索 Agent 的自动工具生成框架
papers.summary_zh: 在精简基础工具库上自动生成并复用工具，提升多模态搜索 agent 的泛化表现。
papers.abstract_zh: 近期的多模态搜索 agent 在多轮中综合推理、视觉和实时网络搜索，借助一小套手工构建的搜索与视觉工具来回答超出参数化知识的问题。然而这套工具库的构建和维护都很费力，而且面对真实场景中出现的新查询类型、新证据格式和新失败模式时是固定不变的。相比之下，人类在工具不足时会用熟悉的部件打造新工具，并在不同任务间复用。受此启发，我们提出 ToolSmith，一个==自动工具生成框架==，在精简的基础工具库之上不断生成并复用模块。我们在 3 个领域内多模态搜索 benchmark 和 10 个领域外 benchmark 上，用 VLM-as-a-Judge 协议评估 ToolSmith。**在不同规模的 agent 上，ToolSmith 均稳定优于基础工具库，且骨干越大收益越大**，说明该方法具有可扩展性。代码和数据见 https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/。
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.

papers.title: Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions
papers.title_zh: Needwise：基于需求级类型化决策的免生成对话式推荐
papers.summary_zh: 用对固定选项输出概率的类型化决策代替 LLM 重读对话，在 Google Local 上 nDCG@10 超过 GPT-6 Sol。
papers.abstract_zh: 对话式推荐系统必须依据目录只部分记录的需求来给物品排序，而用户会添加、撤回、推翻需求，并在不同请求之间切换。LLM ranker 每一轮都要重读对话，速度慢，其排序也无法说明物品满足了哪些需求。我们证明，对话式推荐系统可以由==类型化决策==构建：针对固定选项提出具名问题，用选项概率而非生成文本作答。每一轮中，一次类型化请求把消息映射到目录字段，保留没有字段能表达的用户原话，并决定本轮如何改变先前的各项需求。随后 Needwise 按“必须项优先”对候选排序：物品种类、地点和价格方面的需求构成一个层级，层内把一个整体决策与需求级判定（满足、矛盾或未知）等权合并（Needwise-HF）。在记录中隐去分级属性、必须从名称、描述和评论中推断需求的设置下，Needwise-HF 在 Google Local 请求上的排序显著优于 GPT-6 Sol（nDCG@10 为 **0.383 对 0.343**），在 Google Local 和 Yelp 上与最强的 LLM ranker 没有显著差异；在我们测试的各种未记录属性处理方式下，这些比较的符号都保持不变。它的成本只是 GPT-6 Sol API 价格的一小部分，在 Google Local 上的中位响应时间为 2.5 秒，而 GPT-6 Sol 为 5.6 秒。在多轮对话中，类型化状态能在话题切换和返回时保持排序，但只能识别 **19-27% 的已撤回需求**。
papers.abstract_en: Conversational recommenders must rank items against needs that catalogs record only in part, while users add, withdraw and reverse needs and switch between requests. LLM rankers re-read the dialogue at every turn: they are slow, and their ordering does not show which needs an item meets. We show that a conversational recommender can be built from typed decisions instead: named questions over fixed options, answered with option probabilities rather than generated text. On each turn, one typed request maps the message onto the catalog's fields, keeps what no field expresses in the user's words, and decides how the turn changes each earlier need. Needwise then ranks candidates must-first: the needs on the kind of item, its place and its price form a tier, and within it one holistic decision and need-level verdicts (supported, contradicted or unknown) are combined with equal weight (Needwise-HF). With the graded attributes withheld from the records, so that needs must be inferred from names, descriptions and reviews, Needwise-HF ranks Google Local requests significantly better than GPT-6 Sol (0.383 against 0.343 nDCG@10) and is not significantly different from the strongest LLM ranker on Google Local and Yelp; these comparisons keep their sign under every treatment of unrecorded attributes we test. It costs a fraction of GPT-6 Sol's API price and answers in 2.5 s at the median on Google Local, against 5.6 s for GPT-6 Sol. In conversations, the typed state keeps the ranking across switches and returns, but it recognizes only 19-27% of withdrawn needs.

papers.title: Where Do Fact-Checking Errors Arise? Separating Retrieval, Search Control and Judgement in Evidence-Grounded Verification
papers.title_zh: 事实核查错误出在哪里？分离基于证据验证中的检索、搜索控制与判断
papers.summary_zh: 把事实核查拆成检索、搜索控制、判断与验证来定位错误来源
papers.abstract_zh: 基于证据的事实核查器可能因为没找到证据而出错，也可能因为没用好证据而出错，端到端准确率无法区分两者。我们提出一套协议，沿证据从存储到最终判定的路径追踪，将==检索、搜索控制、判断和判定验证==分开评估。我们用一个 9B 开源权重模型评估来自 FEVER、FEVER 2.0 和 AVeriTeC 的 293 条声明，设置两种证据条件：证据易于发现的、带标注证据的小型存储，以及完整的源文档集合。在对照条件下，单次混合检索对 228 条含证据声明中的 226 条给出了完整参考证据，而自适应控制器和工具 Agent 多花 2 到 9 倍的模型调用，却没有一致的收益。在 34 条被判为证据不足的决定性声明中，33 条的证据包其实包含完整证据：其中 15 条是 judge 弃权，18 条是验证规则推翻了原本的决定性判定。在 AVeriTeC 上，这些规则使单次通过准确率下降六个点，降至 65.0%（平衡准确率 57.6%）。来自八个模型家族的十个 judge 在固定证据包上同样出现弃权和验证转换。面对完整存储时，混合单次通过的准确率**下降 17 到 29 个点**。Wikipedia 证据召回下降；AVeriTeC 的召回从标注答案变为被引用页面，并单独度量。没有任何控制器能挽回这部分准确率损失。Agent 在另外 714 条 Wikipedia 声明上也没有明确收益。在把错误归因于搜索之前，应当分别度量证据召回、判断和验证。
papers.abstract_en: An evidence-grounded fact-checker can fail because it does not find the evidence or because it does not use it; end-to-end accuracy does not tell the two apart. We present a protocol that follows the reference evidence from the store to the verdict and separates retrieval, search control, judgement and verdict validation. We assess 293 claims from FEVER, FEVER 2.0 and AVeriTeC with one open-weights 9B model under two evidence conditions: small stores of annotated evidence, where discovery is easy, and the full source collections. In the control condition a single hybrid retrieval pass delivers complete reference evidence for 226 of 228 evidence-bearing claims, and adaptive controllers and a tool agent spend two to nine times as many model calls without a consistent gain. Of 34 decisive claims labelled as lacking evidence, 33 have the complete evidence in the packet: in 15 the judge abstains, and in 18 validation rules overturn a decisive verdict. On AVeriTeC these rules lower single-pass accuracy by six points, to 65.0% (balanced accuracy 57.6%). Ten judges from eight model families also show abstentions and validation conversions on fixed packets. Against the full stores hybrid single-pass accuracy falls by 17 to 29 points. Wikipedia evidence recovery declines; AVeriTeC recovery changes from annotated answers to cited pages and is measured separately. No controller recovers the accuracy loss. The agent also shows no resolved gain on 714 further Wikipedia claims. Evidence recovery, judgement and validation should be measured separately before an error is attributed to search.

papers.title: MoR4Rec: Mixture-of-Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
papers.title_zh: MoR4Rec:面向序列推荐的递归混合
papers.summary_zh: 用共享Transformer按item自适应递归深度做序列推荐,Recall@5平均提升2.28%
papers.abstract_zh: 序列推荐系统旨在根据用户历史行为中的时间依赖预测下一次交互。为捕捉这类依赖,近期方法越来越多地采用基于注意力的架构,尤其是Transformer。这些模型虽能有效建模长程序列模式,却对所有交互item使用固定的计算深度,把它们视为同等复杂。然而用户行为本质上是异质的:许多交互遵循简单重复的模式,另一些则需要建模更高阶的依赖。这种不匹配导致模型容量利用低效和不必要的计算开销,在深层Transformer架构中尤其明显。为此我们提出==MoR4Rec==,一个基于==递归混合(Mixture-of-Recursion)==范式的序列推荐框架,通过共享的Transformer骨干实现按item自适应的计算。可学习的路由机制动态地为每个item分配合适的递归深度,对复杂交互分配更深的计算,对简单模式则处理得更高效。为提高计算效率,我们设计了跨递归步共享key-value的级联策略,并进一步引入门控注意力机制,在递归序列建模中自适应地调节上下文信息。在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明,MoR4Rec持续优于强Transformer基线,**相对最强基线,Recall@5、NDCG@5、MRR@5平均分别提升2.28%、2.50%和2.0%**。在top-10和top-20推荐截断下提升依然一致,与原始Transformer的比较则体现了自适应递归处理的计算效率。
papers.abstract_en: Sequential recommender systems aim to predict a user's next interaction by modeling temporal dependencies in historical behavior sequences. To capture such dependencies, recent approaches increasingly rely on attention-based architectures, particularly transformers. While effective at modeling long-range sequential patterns, these models apply a fixed computation depth to all interaction items, treating them as equally complex. However, user behavior is inherently heterogeneous, with many interactions following simple repetitive patterns, whereas others require modeling higher-order dependencies. This mismatch leads to inefficient utilization of model capacity and unnecessary computational overhead, particularly in deep transformer-based architectures. To address this issue, we propose MoR4Rec, a sequential recommendation framework based on a Mixture-of-Recursion paradigm, which enables item-wise adaptive computation through a shared transformer backbone. A learned routing mechanism dynamically assigns each item to an appropriate recursion depth, allocating deeper computation to complex interactions while processing simpler patterns more efficiently. To improve computational efficiency, we develop a cascade-based strategy with key-value sharing across recursion steps. We further introduce a gated attention mechanism that adaptively regulates contextual information during recursive sequence modeling. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets show that MoR4Rec consistently outperforms strong transformer-based baselines, achieving average gains of 2.28% in Recall@5, 2.50% in NDCG@5, and 2.0% in MRR@5 over the strongest baseline. The improvements remain consistent across top-10 and top-20 recommendation cutoffs, while comparisons with vanilla transformers demonstrate the computational efficiency of adaptive recursive processing.

papers.title: HME-PFD: Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation
papers.title_zh: HME-PFD：异构混合专家特权特征蒸馏
papers.summary_zh: 把特权特征用于MoE学生模型的路由，提升广告转化预测蒸馏效果。
papers.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏（KD）被广泛用于把大教师模型的知识迁移给小学生模型，以便高效部署机器学习系统。在广告推荐场景中，特权特征蒸馏（PFD）扩展了KD，允许教师模型使用仅在训练时可得的特权特征来提升蒸馏效果。然而在真实场景中，特权特征往往覆盖率有限且分布异构，使得训练样本对蒸馏和模型学习的重要性各不相同。我们提出异构混合专家特权特征蒸馏（==HME-PFD==），将特权特征引入基于混合专家（MoE）的学生模型的==路由模块==。该方法同时设计了硬编码和可学习两种路由模块，使学生模型能根据特权特征的可得性与取值动态决定专家分配。这一设计通过区分高信号与低信号样本，让学生模型更好地处理特权特征部分可观测的异构数据场景。在两个点击后转化预测任务上的大量实验表明，HME-PFD **持续优于基线方法**。结果显示，即使特权特征不完整或稀疏，将其用于学生模型的专家路由也能提升模型性能。
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to transfer knowledge from large teacher models to smaller student models, facilitating efficient serving of machine learning systems. In the context of ads recommendation, privileged features distillation (PFD) extends KD by allowing the teacher model to leverage privileged features, i.e., features available only during training, to enhance distillation performance. However, in real-world scenarios, privileged features often have limited coverage and exhibit heterogeneous distributions, resulting in training examples of varying importance for distillation and model learning. We propose Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation (HME-PFD), a novel approach that incorporates privileged features into the routing module of a Mixture-of-Experts-based student model. Our method introduces both hard-coded and learnable routing modules, enabling the student to dynamically determine expert assignment based on the availability and values of privileged features. This design allows the student model to better handle the heterogeneous data scenario, where privileged features are partially observed, by differentiating between high- and low-signal samples. Extensive experiments on two post-click conversion prediction tasks demonstrate that HME-PFD consistently outperforms baseline methods. Our results show that leveraging privileged features for expert routing in the student model leads to improved model performance, even when privileged features are incomplete or sparse.

papers.title: SuSi-RAG: A Hybrid Graph RAG for Equipment Maintenance
papers.title_zh: SuSi-RAG：面向设备维护的混合 Graph RAG
papers.summary_zh: 用子图相似度匹配查询与维护记录的 Graph RAG，已在博世产线运行八个月。
papers.abstract_zh: 在制造业，设备维护任务依赖专家知识，相关文档往往存放在异构的格式和来源中。用检索增强生成（RAG）增强 LLM 有望整合这些分散的知识，但传统基于向量的 RAG 在真实维护查询常见的两个特点上表现不佳：复杂的因果链和跨领域综合。为此我们提出 SuSi-RAG，一种混合 ==Graph RAG==，用==子图相似度==匹配用户查询与每条维护记录。这项工作展示了一个在用系统：SuSi-RAG 已在博世的一条活跃产线上运行超过八个月，处理了 10,664 次问答交互，答案准确率上界为 96.25%（确认错误率 3.75%）。在概念验证中，相比基于向量的基线，SuSi-RAG 把 top-1 检索准确率从 61.5% 提高到 96.2%，专家评分的答案质量从 44.9% 提高到 84.1%。我们还提出了用于更新 SuSi-RAG 的集成运营反馈闭环。
papers.abstract_en: In the manufacturing domain, equipment maintenance tasks depend on expert knowledge. Their documentation is often stored in heterogeneous formats and sources. The enhancement of LLMs with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is promising for bridging the scattered knowledge, but traditional vector-based RAG shows weaknesses with two characteristics which are common in real maintenance queries: complex causal chains and cross-domain synthesis. To address this, we propose SuSi-RAG, a hybrid Graph RAG solution, that matches a user query and each maintenance record using subgraph similarity. This work shows an in-use system: SuSi-RAG has run on an active Bosch production line for more than eight months, handling 10,664 question-answer interactions and demonstrates upper bound answer accuracy of 96.25% (confirmed error rate 3.75%). In a proof-of-concept, SuSi-RAG improves top-1 retrieval accuracy from 61.5% to 96.2% and expert-rated answer quality from 44.9% to 84.1% against a vector-based baseline. We present an integrated operational feedback loop to update SuSi-RAG.

papers.title: Fetch, Read, Reuse: How AI Search Agents Bend the Web's Rules
papers.title_zh: 获取、阅读、复用：AI 搜索智能体如何绕开网络规则
papers.summary_zh: 黑盒测量各家 AI 搜索智能体对 robots.txt、缓存等规则的遵守情况。
papers.abstract_zh: AI 搜索智能体是一类新兴且增长迅速的网络流量。它们像浏览器一样按需为单个用户抓取页面；像转码代理一样改写所抓取的内容；又像共享缓存一样，用存储的副本回答其他用户的问题。发布者所依赖的 robots.txt、Retry-After 和 Cache-Control 等规则是为更传统的客户端设计的，因此遵守哪些规则由智能体的厂商决定。我们对这些智能体如何抓取、阅读和复用页面做了黑盒测量研究，覆盖 OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI 和 Google 的搜索 API 以及十个服务的消费级应用。我们发现 **OpenAI 和 xAI 不遵守 robots.txt，且没有任何服务响应 Retry-After**。各服务读到的内容比源站提供的少：OpenAI 丢弃部分格式，没有服务读取纯 JavaScript 内容，xAI 只读取页面前 0.5 MB。OpenAI、Anthropic 和 xAI 会跨用户共享已抓取的页面，且基本忽略 Cache-Control，因此答案可能反映 30 分钟到一天甚至更久之前的旧页面。因此发布者缺乏有效的控制：指令只是建议性的、被选择性遵循，描述的是所服务的页面而非改写后的副本，且只限定副本复用多久，不限制它回答多少次。我们公开了代码和数据。
papers.abstract_en: AI search agents form a new and fast-growing class of web traffic. Like a browser, they fetch pages on demand for one user; like a transcoding proxy, they rewrite what they fetch; and like a shared cache, they answer other users' questions from the stored copy. The rules publishers rely on, such as robots.txt, Retry-After, and Cache-Control, were written for more familiar clients, so the agent's vendor decides which of them to follow. We present a black-box measurement study of how these agents fetch, read, and reuse pages, covering the search APIs of OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Google and the consumer apps of ten services. We find that OpenAI and xAI do not honor robots.txt, and no service acts on Retry-After. Services silently read less than the origin served: OpenAI drops some formats, no service reads JavaScript-only content, and xAI reads only the first 0.5 MB of a page. OpenAI, Anthropic, and xAI share fetched pages across users and largely ignore Cache-Control, so answers can reflect outdated pages for 30 minutes to a day or more. Publishers therefore lack effective control: directives are advisory and followed selectively, describe the served page rather than the rewritten copy, and bound how long a copy is reused but not how many answers it serves. We release our code and data.

papers.title: MH-RAG-DIVE: Dynamic and Cost-Efficient Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via Tree-Cached Dialogue Simulation
papers.title_zh: MH-RAG-DIVE：基于树缓存对话模拟的动态低成本多跳 RAG 评测
papers.summary_zh: 用对话模拟与缓存做多跳多轮 RAG 的动态评测并降低 token 开销。
papers.abstract_zh: 质量评估对于判断 RAG 系统的改动是否提升或维持性能至关重要。然而现有评估方法往往依赖单轮或单跳交互，无法刻画多跳、多轮对话的复杂性。我们提出 MH-RAG-DIVE，一个==动态交互式用户模拟框架==，用于在更复杂的多跳多轮场景中评估 RAG 系统。该框架在 RAG-DIVE 基础上增加了 Context Discoverer，用于找出可在进行中的对话里组合起来生成多跳问题的文档。为应对动态用户模拟的高计算成本，我们进一步提出 ==Conversation Cacher==，在保留评估动态性的同时复用此前评估运行中的对话轮次。我们在六种不同的 RAG 配置上评估该框架，并与原始 RAG-DIVE 评估以及人工构建的静态数据集 CLAPNQ 比较。实验显示三种评估方式的性能趋势一致，而更复杂的多跳多轮设置暴露出 RAG 系统更多的挑战。此外，**Conversation Cacher 大幅降低了 token 消耗**，说明动态评估有望更低成本。最后，我们把 MH-RAG-DIVE 应用于带领域数据的工业 RAG 系统，验证其在真实评估场景中的适用性。总体而言，该方法提供了更复杂且更低成本的 RAG 评估框架。代码与实验数据已在 GitHub 公开（https://github.com/Daniel-Innsbruck/MH-RAG-DIVE）。
papers.abstract_en: Quality assessment is essential for determining whether changes to a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system improve or maintain its performance. However, existing evaluation approaches often rely on single-turn or single-hop interactions and therefore do not capture the complexity of multi-hop, multi-turn conversations. We introduce MH-RAG-DIVE, a dynamic interactive user simulation framework designed to evaluate RAG systems in more complex multi-hop and multi-turn settings. The framework extends RAG-DIVE with a Context Discoverer, which identifies documents that can be combined to generate multi-hop questions within an ongoing conversation. To address the high computational cost of dynamic user simulation, we further introduce a Conversation Cacher, which reuses turns from previous evaluation runs while preserving the dynamic nature of the evaluation. We evaluate the framework across six distinct RAG configurations and compare its results with the original RAG-DIVE evaluation and the static, human-created CLAPNQ dataset. Our experiments show consistent performance trends across the evaluation approaches, while the more complex multi-hop and multi-turn setting exposes additional challenges for RAG systems. Furthermore, the Conversation Cacher substantially reduces token consumption, demonstrating its potential to make dynamic evaluation more cost-efficient. Finally, we apply MH-RAG-DIVE to an industrial RAG system with domain-specific data, demonstrating its applicability to real-world evaluation scenarios. Overall, our results show that the proposed approach provides a more complex and cost-efficient framework for evaluating RAG systems. All code and experimental data are publicly available in our GitHub repository (https://github.com/Daniel-Innsbruck/MH-RAG-DIVE).

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation in the Agentic Era: Tradition, Present, and Prospect
papers.title_zh: Agent 时代的检索增强生成：传统、现状与展望
papers.summary_zh: 按离线索引、检索前、检索、检索后和编排的生命周期梳理 Agent 时代的 RAG。
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）把冻结的语言模型与可更新的外部知识结合起来，使生成以检索到的证据为依据，而不只依赖参数记忆。本文把 RAG 放在 Agent 时代，用一条统一的生命周期主线将它们串起来：从离线索引，到检索前、检索、检索后，再到对这些阶段的编排。本文把索引和编排视为一等组件，把 Agent 工作流视为独立范式，并涵盖此前综述之后出现的 Agent 相关工作。除这些组件外，还讨论评测、应用以及有待探索的开放问题。从传统到现状再到未来，本文从 Agent 时代的视角系统综述 RAG。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) couples frozen language models with external, updatable knowledge, so that generation is grounded in retrieved evidence rather than in parametric memory alone. This work maps RAG in the agentic era by joining them on a single lifecycle axis, from offline indexing through pre-retrieval, retrieval, post-retrieval, and orchestration over these stages. It treats indexing and orchestration as first-class components and agentic workflows as a paradigm of their own, and it covers the agentic work that has appeared since those reviews. Beyond these components, it covers evaluation, applications, and the questions that remain open for future exploration. From tradition to present and beyond, this work systematically reviews RAG from a perspective of the agentic era.

papers.title: Beyond Knowledge Transfer: How User Overlap Shapes Diversity in Cross-Domain Recommendation
papers.title_zh: 超越知识迁移：用户重叠如何影响跨域推荐的多样性
papers.summary_zh: 提出 DivCDR，用 Push–Pull 框架在跨域推荐中提高多样性并保持准确率。
papers.abstract_zh: 跨域推荐（CDR）的常见范式是通过源域和目标域共有的用户迁移知识。这座重叠“桥梁”虽能提升准确率，但对多样性的影响尚不清楚。我们指出两个瓶颈：重叠用户覆盖的目标域兴趣有限时，桥梁==太窄==；共享信号压过非重叠用户稀疏的个人证据时，桥梁又==太响==。为此我们提出 DivCDR，一个与模型无关的 ==Push–Pull 框架==。Pull 为重叠用户构造由置信度门控的虚拟正样本，并优化其曝光熵增益，以拓宽桥梁所携带的偏好。Push 用基于重叠密度的负采样，把非重叠用户推离重叠密集的区域。在三个数据集和五个代表性 CDR 骨干模型上的实验表明，**DivCDR 在多数设置下提升推荐多样性，同时保持或提高准确率**。
papers.abstract_en: A common paradigm in cross-domain recommendation (CDR) transfers knowledge through users shared by source and target domains. Although this overlap bridge is effective in improving accuracy, its effect on diversity remains unclear. We identify two bottlenecks: the bridge can be too narrow when overlapping users cover limited target-domain tastes, and too loud when shared signals dominate the sparse personal evidence of non-overlapping users. To address both, we propose DivCDR, a model-agnostic Push--Pull framework. Pull constructs confidence-gated virtual positives for overlapping users and optimizes their exposure-entropy gain, broadening the preferences carried by the bridge. Push uses overlap-density-guided negative sampling to move non-overlapping users away from overlap-dense regions. Experiments on three datasets and five representative CDR backbones show that DivCDR improves recommendation diversity while preserving or improving accuracy in most settings.

papers.title: Structure-Exploiting Hierarchical Retrieval for Long Narrative Documents: A Precision-Oriented Alternative to Learned Abstraction Trees
papers.title_zh: 面向长篇叙事文档的结构利用式分层检索：学习式抽象树的高精度替代方案
papers.summary_zh: 利用书籍章节结构做两级检索，在QuALITY上优于平铺检索，与RAPTOR互有取舍。
papers.abstract_zh: 面向整本书级文档的检索增强生成，需要在数万token内定位少量连贯的段落。平铺式稠密检索忽略了文档结构；RAPTOR则通过递归聚类并用语言模型摘要来构建层级。我们研究一种互补的设计：利用文档原生结构的==两级检索器==，(i) 在章节概要上用BM25+稠密混合匹配选出章节，(ii) 执行限定章节的稠密检索，(iii) 在token预算下将top段落扩展为连续、感知小节的片段，并配合基于内容哈希的==增量摄取==以降低索引更新成本。我们在五本公版书籍（113条章节定位查询）以及QuALITY和NovelQA（20万+ token的小说）上评测。在内部评测中，我们发现一个跨随机种子稳定的精度/排序权衡：关闭小节扩展时，分层检索返回来自正确章节的chunk比例更高（+3.3pp，Wilcoxon p=0.014）；开启扩展时，排序（MRR）得到改善（p=0.040）。准确率差异不显著。在QuALITY上，**分层检索优于平铺top-k（81.0% 对 70.4%，p=0.0019）**，与读取全文持平（p=0.74）。在NovelQA上，分层与平铺检索在统计上持平（55.7% 对 56.8%，p=0.24）；分层有助于聚合类问题，而平铺在局部事实上更好。与忠实复现的RAPTOR基线相比，我们发现的是互补的权衡，而非优势。增量摄取在增量编辑时可复用**94%至99.7%的embedding**。我们不声称能语义推断章节边界，结论仅限于英文叙事散文。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation over book-length documents must locate a small, coherent set of passages inside tens of thousands of tokens. Flat dense retrieval ignores document structure; RAPTOR instead builds a hierarchy by recursively clustering and summarizing with a language model. We study a complementary design that exploits the native structure of a document: a two-level retriever that (i) selects chapters with a hybrid BM25+dense match over chapter recaps, (ii) runs a chapter-filtered dense search, and (iii) expands top passages into contiguous, section-aware spans under a token budget, plus content-hash-gated delta ingestion to keep the index cheap to update. We evaluate on five public-domain books (113 chapter-localization queries) and on QuALITY and NovelQA (200K+ token novels). In-house, we find a seed-stable precision/ranking tradeoff: with section expansion off, hierarchical retrieval returns a higher fraction of chunks from the correct chapter (+3.3pp, Wilcoxon p=0.014); with expansion on, ranking improves (MRR, p=0.040). Accuracy differences are not significant. On QuALITY, hierarchical retrieval beats flat top-k (81.0% vs 70.4%, p=0.0019) and matches the full article (p=0.74). On NovelQA, hierarchical and flat retrieval are statistically tied (55.7% vs 56.8%, p=0.24); hierarchy helps aggregation questions while flat wins on localized facts. Against a faithful RAPTOR baseline we find a complementary tradeoff, not superiority. Delta ingestion reuses 94 to 99.7% of embeddings on incremental edits. We make no claim of semantic chapter-boundary inference and scope claims to English narrative prose.

papers.title: Make Position Uninformative: Exchangeable Self-Distillation Flattens the Lost-in-the-Middle Curve
papers.title_zh: 让位置不携带信息：可交换自蒸馏抹平“中间丢失”曲线
papers.summary_zh: 用打乱上下文的自蒸馏训练小adapter，缓解RAG阅读器的位置偏置。
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强语言模型在相关文档位于开头或结尾时回答良好，位于中间时表现较差。一些微调方案通过压低开头位置的表现来抬高中间位置。我们研究了训练上下文如何让模型学到位置偏置：当答案槽位均匀分布且干扰文档被打乱时，最优阅读器会忽略位置。基于这一结果，我们提出==Exchangeable Self-Distillation（ExSD）==：在打乱的上下文上训练一个小adapter，使其复现模型单独阅读答案文档时给出的答案。该方法不需要标准答案，只需几千条样本。在1.5B到32B的六个模型上，ExSD相比冻结模型同时提高了平均准确率和最差位置准确率，在保留测试集上同样如此。在受控的LoRA对比中，它在这两项指标上均显著优于Pos2Distill。与CORD相比，平均差异不显著，但在20篇和30篇文档设置下**最差位置准确率的提升在统计上显著**。ExSD还能持平或超过用标准答案的微调，对其他任务行为的改变小得多，并可迁移到未见任务。注意力头探测显示，模型更依赖内容而非位置。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented language models answer well when the relevant document comes first or last and poorly when it sits in the middle. Some fine-tuning recipes lift the middle by lowering the start. We show how training contexts teach positional bias. With a uniform answer slot and shuffled distractors, the optimal reader ignores position. Building on this result, Exchangeable Self-Distillation (ExSD) trains a small adapter on shuffled contexts to reproduce the model's answer when it reads the answer document alone. It needs no gold answers and only a few thousand examples. On six models from 1.5B to 32B parameters, ExSD raises both average and worst-position accuracy against the frozen model, including on a held-out test split. In controlled LoRA comparisons, it significantly improves both criteria over Pos2Distill. Against CORD, mean differences are not significant, while worst-position accuracy improves significantly in the 20- and 30-document settings. ExSD also matches or beats gold-answer fine-tuning, changes behavior on other tasks far less, and transfers to unseen tasks. Head probes show greater reliance on content over position.

papers.title: DM-Lab at TREC 2026 RAG: Multi-Query Retrieval, Ensemble Judging, and Claim-Pack Generation
papers.title_zh: DM-Lab 在 TREC 2026 RAG 的参赛系统：多查询检索、集成评判与断言包生成
papers.summary_zh: TREC 2026 RAG 参赛系统，多查询 BM25 加重排与断言优先生成
papers.abstract_zh: 团队提交 DM-Lab-RAG-2026，用于 TREC 2026 RAG 赛道，在 5.53 亿文档的 ClimbMix-400B 语料上完成大规模证据检索和带引用的答案生成。检索部分结合多查询 BM25、倒数排名融合、集成相关性判断、listwise 重排序和自适应检索深度。生成部分采用==断言优先==策略：先抽取带证据链接的原子断言，再构造带引用的回答并验证来源支持。在 22 个开发主题上，检索系统平均 nDCG@30 为 0.604；官方评测中 set precision 为 0.455，人工 nugget gain 为 0.910。补充实验考察了重排序、证据选择和引用验证对系统表现的影响。评测表明多样化的词法检索和基于语言模型的相关性判断适合大规模证据发现，同时指出证据保留和结构化答案构建是可靠 RAG 的关键。该工作提供了一个可复现的框架，用于研究检索效果和有证据支撑的生成。
papers.abstract_en: We present DM-Lab-RAG-2026, a framework developed for the TREC 2026 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) track. The framework integrates large-scale evidence retrieval and citation-grounded answer generation over the 553-million-document ClimbMix-400B corpus. The retrieval architecture combines multi-query BM25, reciprocal rank fusion, ensemble relevance assessment, listwise reranking, and adaptive retrieval depth. The generation pipeline employs a claim-first strategy to extract evidence-linked atomic claims, construct cited responses, and verify source support. Across 22 development topics, the retrieval system achieved a mean nDCG@30 of 0.604. In the official evaluation, it attained a set precision of 0.455 and a manual nugget gain of 0.910. Additional experiments examine the influence of reranking, evidence selection, and citation verification on system performance. The evaluation demonstrates the potential of diversified lexical retrieval and language-model-based relevance assessment for large-scale evidence discovery. It further identifies evidence preservation and structured answer construction as key considerations for reliable RAG. This work provides a reproducible framework for investigating retrieval effectiveness and evidence-grounded generation.

papers.title: Towards Agentic Video Corpus Moment Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 迈向智能体式视频语料时刻检索
papers.summary_zh: 训练-free 框架 RELAY，跨查询共享记忆完成视频检索与定位
papers.abstract_zh: 视频语料时刻检索（VCMR）需要在视频语料中找出与文本查询匹配的视频及时间区间。我们提出 RELAY，一个跨查询共享记忆的==免训练== VCMR 框架。RELAY 分三个阶段处理一批查询：用查询库搜索、用视频笔记排序、用视频 prompt 缓存定位。搜索阶段由 embedding 模型按最匹配帧给每个视频打分，查询库会惩罚对批内许多其他查询都得高分的视频。排序阶段由视觉语言模型（VLM）一次性写下每个候选视频的场景、人物、物体和动作笔记，再由大语言模型（LLM）依据这些笔记重排候选。定位阶段由 VLM 预测排名最高视频中时刻的时间区间；多个查询选中同一视频时，prompt 缓存让 VLM 复用其帧。在三个 VERIFIED 基准上，**RELAY 无需训练，视频检索 R@1 超过经过训练的基线**。在没有任何标注时刻的情况下，其预测区间比标注的更短。在 VCMR 上，它在一个基准上与 VideoSearch-R1 表现相近，在另外两个基准的 IoU 0.5 上稍逊。人工标注者标出的时刻也比基准原始标注更短。用少量带标注查询校准的单一 margin 就能把预测区间放宽到基准的标注惯例，此时 RELAY 在 IoU 0.5 的 VCMR 上超过经过训练的基线。
papers.abstract_en: Video corpus moment retrieval (VCMR) requires finding the video and time interval that match a text query in a corpus of videos. We present RELAY, a training-free framework for VCMR that shares memory across queries. RELAY processes a batch of queries in three stages: search with a query bank, ranking with video notes, and localization with video prompt caching. In the search stage, an embedding model scores each video by its best-matching frame. The query bank penalizes videos that score highly for many other queries in the batch. In the ranking stage, a vision-language model (VLM) writes notes on each candidate video's scenes, people, objects, and actions once. Then, a large language model (LLM) reranks the candidates from these notes. In the localization stage, a VLM predicts the time interval of the moment in the top-ranked video. When multiple queries select the same video, prompt caching lets the VLM reuse its frames. On the three VERIFIED benchmarks, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in video retrieval R@1 without training. Without any labeled moment, its predicted intervals are shorter than the annotated ones. In VCMR, it achieves similar performance to VideoSearch-R1 on one benchmark and trails it at IoU 0.5 on the other two. Human annotators also mark shorter moments than the original annotations of the benchmarks. A single margin, calibrated on a few labeled queries, widens the predicted interval to the annotation convention of the benchmarks. With it, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in VCMR at IoU 0.5.

papers.title: VistaTree: Question Answering over Long Multimodal Documents with Image-Derived Summary Trees
papers.title_zh: VistaTree:基于图像派生摘要树的长多模态文档问答
papers.summary_zh: 从页面图像构建摘要树,让智能体分层导航检索长多模态文档
