papers.abstract_zh: 回答长多模态文档的问题需要在包含文本、表格和图的页面中定位相关证据。当文档超出模型上下文窗口时,选择性检索就成为必需。我们提出==VistaTree==,一个直接从渲染的页面图像构建==摘要树==的文档问答智能体。VistaTree把文档切分成连续的页面段,递归地将其归为主题层次,并精炼同级摘要以区分相邻章节。查询时,智能体利用节点摘要选择相关节点并读取对应页面;当完整大纲超出上下文预算时,使用分层导航。我们在MMLongBench-Doc和LongDocURL上,使用本地部署的视觉语言模型评测回答质量和检索成本,并量化了全局访问与分层访问索引之间的性能差距。
papers.abstract_en: Answering questions over long multimodal documents requires locating relevant evidence across pages containing text, tables, and figures. When the document exceeds the model's context window, selective retrieval becomes necessary. We introduce VistaTree, a document question-answering agent that builds a summary tree directly from rendered page images. VistaTree segments documents into contiguous page spans, recursively groups them into a topic hierarchy, and refines sibling summaries to distinguish neighboring sections. At query time, the agent uses node summaries to select relevant nodes and reads the corresponding pages, using hierarchical navigation when the full outline exceeds the context budget. Experiments on MMLongBench-Doc and LongDocURL evaluate answer quality and retrieval cost using a locally hosted vision-language model, and quantify the performance gap between global and hierarchical access to the index.

papers.title: ContextFact: Remembering Facts in Context for Long-Term Conversational Agents
papers.title_zh: ContextFact：为长期对话智能体在上下文中记住事实
papers.summary_zh: 保留上下文的事实记忆与实体表征，用于长对话记忆检索
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体必须在与用户的反复交互中保持连续性。然而长期对话把事实分散在不同轮次和会话中，难以在足够上下文下检索到正确证据。因此这类对话的记忆必须带着上下文保存事实，同时让证据可被选择性访问。我们首先研究记忆构建和检索单元边界如何影响可回答性与证据获取。读取整个记忆库会暴露出仅靠检索选择无法弥补的缺口，说明构建记忆时必须保留部分上下文。在相同的唯一轮次预算下，相邻轮次分组能改善证据获取，而更宽的窗口并不稳定有效。这促使我们把针对事实的上下文保持在局部，同时单独组织跨会话证据。我们提出 ==ContextFact==，它把保留上下文的事实记忆与有源对话依据的实体表征相连。在会话内，它收集解释每条事实所需的上下文；跨会话时，它对齐反复出现的指代对象，并回看源对话以重建与支撑事实相连的连贯实体表征。查询时，ContextFact 检索事实和实体两种视图，分别重排，并通过实体关联扩展找出相关事实；完整的实体表征再提供有组织的跨会话证据。以 Qwen3.5-27B 为骨干，ContextFact 达到最先进水平，**只用最强基线 21% 的证据 token**，在 LoCoMo 上总体评审准确率为 86.49%，在 LongMemEval-S 上为 91.00%。对照消融支持保留上下文的事实边界和有源依据的实体重建，而实体读出在增加更多事实之外进一步提升了多跳准确率。
papers.abstract_en: Agents built on large language models must maintain continuity across repeated interactions with users. However, long-term conversations scatter facts across turns and sessions, making it difficult to retrieve the right evidence with enough context. Memory for such conversations must therefore preserve facts with their context while keeping evidence selectively accessible. We first study how memory construction and retrieval-unit boundaries affect answerability and evidence access. Reading the entire memory bank reveals gaps that cannot be resolved by retrieval selection alone, showing that some context must be preserved during memory construction. Adjacent-turn grouping improves evidence access at matched unique-turn budgets, while wider windows do not consistently help. This motivates keeping fact-specific context local while organizing cross-session evidence separately. We propose ContextFact, which links context-preserving fact memories with source-grounded entity representations. Within sessions, it gathers the context needed to interpret each fact. Across sessions, it aligns recurring referents and revisits the source dialogue to reconstruct coherent entity representations linked to the supporting facts. At query time, ContextFact retrieves fact and entity views, reranks them independently, and uses entity-linked expansion to surface related facts; complete entity representations then provide organized cross-session evidence. With Qwen3.5-27B as the backbone, ContextFact achieves state-of-the-art performance while using only $21\%$ of the evidence tokens consumed by the strongest evaluated baseline, obtaining $86.49\%$ overall judge accuracy on LoCoMo and $91.00\%$ on LongMemEval-S. Controlled ablations support context-preserving fact boundaries and source-grounded entity reconstruction, while entity readout improves multi-hop accuracy beyond adding more facts.

papers.title: Beyond Single-Turn Privacy: Training-Data Leakage in Conversational RAG
papers.title_zh: 超越单轮隐私:对话式RAG中的训练数据泄露
papers.summary_zh: 提出CRELT逐轮追踪对话式RAG的训练数据泄露
papers.abstract_zh: 已知RAG能降低单轮交互中的训练数据泄露,但这种保护在多轮对话中是否依然成立尚不清楚。我们提出CRELT(Conversational RAG Extraction Leakage Trajectory),一个可复用的框架,逐轮追踪RAG系统披露的训练数据中的真实联系方式。CRELT通过全因子设计将检索、对话历史与攻击策略分离,使用经验证不含任何目标PII的检索语料,且仅当某条信息在其被生成的那一轮不在模型输入中时才计为泄露。在主实验中,这一标准排除了29-53%已存在于输入中的原始匹配。在GPT-J-6B、Pythia-6.9B和Pythia-12B上针对真实的Enron联系方式,检索在完整历史和清空历史下都降低了泄露,与此前单轮结果一致。使用随机段落的等长对照在清空历史下复现了这一降幅的91-99.5%,在完整历史下复现47-78%,说明大部分降幅来自增加的上下文而非检索到的内容。然而启用检索时,**保留完整对话历史会使泄露增加3.6-4.9倍**,仅保留前一轮就已恢复到接近完整历史的泄露水平。启用检索时清空历史可使泄露降低72-79%,但无法消除。这些结果表明,单轮隐私审计会大幅低估对话式RAG系统的训练数据泄露,==对话历史策略==是隐私评估的关键维度。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is known to reduce training-data leakage in single-turn interactions, but whether this protection persists over multi-turn conversations is unclear. We introduce CRELT (Conversational RAG Extraction Leakage Trajectory), a reusable framework that tracks, turn by turn, the real contact details from the training data that a RAG system discloses. CRELT separates retrieval, conversation history, and attack strategy through a full-factorial design, uses a retrieval corpus verified to contain none of the target PII, and counts an item as leaked only when it is absent from the model input at the turn it is produced. In our main experiment, this criterion excludes 29-53% of raw matches that were already present in the input. Across GPT-J-6B, Pythia-6.9B, and Pythia-12B, targeting real Enron contact details, retrieval reduces disclosure under both full and cleared history, consistent with prior single-turn results. A length-matched control with random passages reproduces 91-99.5% of this reduction under cleared history and 47-78% under full history, so much of it comes from the added context rather than from what is retrieved. With retrieval enabled, however, retaining full conversation history increases disclosure by a factor of 3.6-4.9, while retaining only one previous turn already restores disclosure to approximately the full-history level. With retrieval, clearing the history reduces disclosure by 72-79%, but does not eliminate it. These results show that single-turn privacy audits can substantially underestimate training-data leakage in conversational RAG systems and that conversation-history policy is a critical dimension of privacy evaluation.

papers.title: MADRec: Reliable Multi-Agent Reasoning with Evidence-Grounded Debate for Recommendation
papers.title_zh: MADRec：基于证据落地辩论的可靠多智能体推荐推理
papers.summary_zh: 多智能体辩论加证据检索推理，并校准排序，提高LLM推荐推理的可靠性。
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正推动推荐系统从传统的偏好匹配转向以推理为驱动、可解释的决策。多智能体协作把推荐推理分散到各个专门的智能体上，进一步推进了这一范式。然而，现有框架很少评估协作过程中中间推理的可靠性，导致错误判断在智能体之间传播，最终拉低推荐质量。为此我们提出基于多智能体辩论的推荐框架MADRec，一个==以证据为依据的多智能体框架==，用于增强多智能体推荐推理的可靠性。MADRec由三个协同模块组成。第一，多智能体辩论（MAD）模块让交互智能体和语义智能体分别从交互信号和内容语义信号两个互补角度分析，通过结构化辩论产生多样的推荐判断。第二，证据落地的检索增强推理（EG-RAR）模块把语义智能体的推理建立在物品级证据之上，并通过评估证据对相应语义论断的支持程度来修正候选打分。第三，基于裁判的排序校准（JRC）模块利用辩论产生的可靠性线索，自适应地校准基于交互和基于语义的排序结果，得到最终推荐。在三个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，**MADRec稳定优于有竞争力的基线**，并提高了多智能体推荐推理的可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming recommender systems from conventional preference matching toward reasoning-driven and explainable decision-making. Multi-agent collaboration further advances this paradigm by distributing recommendation reasoning across specialized agents. However, existing frameworks rarely assess the reliability of intermediate reasoning during collaboration, allowing erroneous judgments to propagate across agents and ultimately degrade recommendation quality. To address this issue, we propose Multi-Agent Debate-based Recommendation (MADRec), an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework that enhances the reliability of multi-agent recommendation reasoning. MADRec consists of three coordinated modules. First, the Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) module enables an Interaction Agent and a Semantic Agent to analyze interaction signals and content-level semantic signals from complementary perspectives, generating diverse recommendation judgments through structured debate. Second, the Evidence-Grounded Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning (EG-RAR) module grounds the Semantic Agent's reasoning in item-level evidence and refines candidate scores by assessing how well the evidence supports the corresponding semantic claims. Third, the Judge-based Ranking Calibration (JRC) module leverages debate-derived reliability cues to adaptively calibrate interaction-based and semantic ranking results for the final recommendation. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that MADRec consistently outperforms competitive baselines and enhances the reliability of multi-agent recommendation reasoning.

papers.title: Where Compositionality Hides: Shared-Content Interference in Vision-Language Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 组合性藏在哪里：视觉语言检索中的共享内容干扰
papers.summary_zh: 用均值擦除分离 Winoground 中的图像间比较与文本偏好误差
papers.abstract_zh: Winoground 等成对组合性基准要求每张图选中匹配的描述，每条描述也选中匹配的图。Group 判定失败既可能来自错误的描述偏好，也可能仅来自跨图比较，而 Group Score 把两者混在一起。要决定是重训编码器还是改打分规则，就需要把二者分开。我们研究==均值擦除==：把每个冻结的图像 embedding 投影到远离两条候选描述归一化均值的方向。我们证明这一投影保持每张图内部的描述排序，并使 Group Score 等于基线 Text Score。在 Winoground 上，均值擦除把 CLIP ViT-B/32 的 Group Score 从 9% 提到 31%，五个 CLIP 和 SigLIP 检查点提升 21 到 27 个百分点。ColorSwap 上对颜色-物体绑定也有类似提升。得分分解显示，约 60% 的 Image 失败样本其实已把正确的联合配对打分高于交换配对，只是败在两张图之间的偏移上。固定修正和学习的双线性打分器提升不足一个百分点。从检索到的描述估计方向，两条描述时提升约五个点，十六条时低于基线。**在为成对检索重训编码器之前，应先测量均值擦除能恢复的 Group 损失：要超过基线 Text Score，必须改变描述本身的判定。**
papers.abstract_en: Paired compositional benchmarks such as Winoground ask each image to prefer its matching caption and each caption to prefer its matching image. A failed Group decision can come from a wrong caption preference or from the cross-image comparison alone, and Group Score merges the two. Choosing between retraining the encoder and changing the scoring rule therefore requires separating them. We study mean-erasure, which projects each frozen image embedding away from the mean of the two normalized candidate captions. We prove that the projection preserves every within-image caption ranking and makes Group Score equal baseline Text Score. On Winoground, mean-erasure raises CLIP ViT-B/32 Group Score from 9% to 31%, and five CLIP and SigLIP checkpoints gain 21 to 27 percentage points. ColorSwap shows a similar gain for color-object binding. A score decomposition shows that about 60% of Image failures already score the correct joint assignment above the swapped one and fail only on an offset between the two images. Fixed corrections and a learned bilinear scorer gain under one point. A direction estimated from retrieved captions gains about five points with two captions and falls below baseline with sixteen. Before retraining an encoder for paired retrieval, measure the Group loss that mean-erasure recovers: gains beyond baseline Text Score require changing the caption decisions themselves.

papers.title: AirVT-15k: A Query-Diverse UAV Video-Text Dataset and Query-Adaptive Evidence Alignment Network for Retrieval
papers.title_zh: AirVT-15k：查询多样的无人机视频文本数据集与查询自适应证据对齐网络
papers.summary_zh: 发布无人机视频文本检索基准并提出查询自适应对齐网络
papers.abstract_zh: 无人机视频文本检索（UAV-TVR）需要把语言同时匹配到场景上下文和细微的物体变化上。查询“港口布局”依赖全局场景，而“船只驶离”需要局部功能线索和运动状态。现有基准提供多样的航拍描述，但很少关注同一视频内不同的证据需求。我们提出 AirVT-15k，包含 15,504 个无人机视频和 155,040 条描述，每个视频有十条互补的双语描述，覆盖场景、物体状态和时序变化。我们还提出 ==AirFocus-CST==，它选择与查询相关的帧和 patch，编码时序特征差异，并结合由粗到细交互（CFI）与最优传输对齐（OTA）。平均召回在 AirVT-15k 上达到 63.67%，在 CapERA 上达到 24.41%，分别比最强基线高 2.96 和 1.91 个百分点。数据集和代码见 https://chenxi000233.github.io/AirVT-15k-site/。
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle video-text retrieval (UAV-TVR) requires matching language to both scene context and subtle object changes. A harbor-layout query relies on global scene context, whereas a departing-vessel query requires local functional cues and motion states. Existing benchmarks provide diverse aerial descriptions but give limited attention to distinct evidence needs within the same video. We introduce AirVT-15k, a benchmark of 15,504 UAV videos and 155,040 captions, with ten complementary bilingual captions per video describing scenes, object states, and temporal changes. We also propose AirFocus-CST, which selects query-relevant frames and patches, encodes temporal feature differences, and combines coarse-to-fine interaction (CFI) with optimal-transport alignment (OTA). Average mean recall reaches 63.67% on AirVT-15k and 24.41% on CapERA, improving over the strongest baselines by 2.96 and 1.91 percentage points, respectively. The dataset and code are available at https://chenxi000233.github.io/AirVT-15k-site/.

papers.title: SARA: An Auditor-in-the-Loop LLM Recommender for Sustainability Reports
papers.title_zh: SARA：面向可持续发展报告的审计员在环 LLM 推荐系统
papers.summary_zh: 把可持续报告审计建模为基于内容的推荐，用主题预测过滤降低 LLM 匹配成本。
papers.abstract_zh: 审计企业可持续发展报告时，鉴证专业人员需要把针对具体公司、约 1,700 条监管要求组成的检查清单，对应到反复修订的冗长报告草稿中的相关段落，并判断合规性。我们提出 SARA（Sustainability Reporting Assistant），一个以 Microsoft Word 插件形式交付的人机协同推荐系统：它为每条要求推荐相关段落并预测合规结论，同时让审计员保持完全控制。SARA 将审计视为在固定监管分类体系上的基于内容的推荐，并通过主题预测过滤让逐条要求的 LLM 匹配更便宜、更快、更准：在专家标注的报告上，与把整份报告输入 LLM 相比，匹配成本降低约六倍，**运行时间减少 42%**。该系统已在普华永道德国的可持续发展鉴证业务中投入使用。
papers.abstract_en: Auditing corporate sustainability reports requires assurance professionals to map a company-specific checklist drawn from roughly 1,700 regulatory requirements onto the relevant passages of lengthy, repeatedly revised draft reports and to judge compliance. We present SARA (Sustainability Reporting Assistant), a human-in-the-loop recommender system delivered as a Microsoft Word add-in that recommends, for each requirement, the passages addressing it and predicts a compliance verdict while keeping the auditor in full control. SARA casts auditing as content-based recommendation over a fixed regulatory taxonomy and makes per-requirement large language model (LLM) matching cheaper, faster, and more accurate through topic-prediction filtering: on expert-annotated reports, it reduces matching cost about sixfold and runtime by 42% versus feeding the full report to the LLM. It is in production use across PwC Germany's sustainability-assurance practice.

papers.title: Skill-Composer: Requirement-Driven Skill Selection from Multiple Marketplaces
papers.title_zh: Skill-Composer：跨多个市场按需求选择技能
papers.summary_zh: 把技能获取从单项排序改为集合选择，选出覆盖需求且不冗余的技能包。
papers.abstract_zh: Agent skill 已成为智能体复用专门能力的主要载体，但公开的技能市场只提供单个条目：无论通过关键词还是 embedding 相似度匹配，查询返回的都是按相关性或热度排序的单个技能列表。这样的接口回答不了开发者真正面对的问题：为了覆盖任务的完整需求，应该安装哪一组技能？排名靠前的技能往往功能冗余，而真正需要的能力却没有覆盖。本文主张把技能获取从排序重新定义为==集合选择==。我们提出 Skill-Composer，一个面向智能体的框架，为用户需求选出非冗余的技能包，目标是覆盖所有可得的所需能力并报告缺口。具体做法是：把用户需求澄清为原子需求点，在分散的多个市场中检索并合并候选技能，分解每个候选的能力，并逐步剔除重叠的技能，使每个保留的技能提供不同的能力。这把“获取哪些技能”的决定从开发者转移给了智能体本身。我们阐述了这一重新定义并勾勒了其工作流程。
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills have become the primary vehicle through which agents reuse specialized capabilities, yet public skill marketplaces provide skills with individual items: a query, whether matched through keyword or embedding similarity, returns a list of single skills ordered by relevance or by popularity. Such an interface cannot answer the question a developer actually faces: which set of skills should be installed to cover a task's complete requirement? The highest-ranked skills are often functionally redundant, while capabilities that are genuinely required remain uncovered. In this paper, we argue that skill acquisition should be reframed from ranking to set selection. We propose Skill-Composer, an agent-native framework that selects a non-redundant skill bundle for the user requirement, which aims to cover all available required capabilities and report any gaps. Specifically, it clarifies user requirements into atomic requirement points, retrieves and merges candidate skills across fragmented marketplaces, decomposes each candidate's capabilities, and progressively discards overlapping ones, so that each retained skill provides different capabilities. This moves the decision of which skills to acquire from the developer to the agent itself. We position this reframing and sketch its workflow.

papers.title: Automatic Construction of Persian E-Commerce Dialogue Datasets for Conversational Product Search
papers.title_zh: 面向对话式商品搜索的波斯语电商对话数据集自动构建
papers.summary_zh: 自动从Digikala目录构建波斯语对话式商品搜索数据集，并提出RPB提问选择分数
papers.abstract_zh: 对话式商品搜索让用户通过多轮对话而非单个关键词查询来查找商品，但波斯语缺乏训练和评估此类系统所需的大规模对话数据集；现有波斯语电商对话资源覆盖品类少、商品目录小。我们提出一个框架，可从真实电商目录自动构建这样的数据集，并发布所得数据集。该框架爬取 Digikala 市场七个品类的 12,926 件商品，将其归为 170 个语义一致的簇，并用 ==Regularized Partition Balance（RPB）分数==在每一轮选择助手要问的问题。RPB 分数同时考虑特征覆盖度、用户能否回答的概率以及取值数量，是基于熵的问题选择方法的推广。随后由 LLM 把每个提问计划转写成自然的波斯语对话。在完整目录上的模拟中，当各特征回答难度不同时，**RPB 分数比最强的熵基线少用 0.11 轮**；难度相同时两者基本等价。仅使用免费的 LLM API，我们生成了覆盖全部 170 个簇的 1,000 条需求驱动对话，并带有逐轮特征标注；自动检查和 LLM 评审确认其与目录一致，但真实感低于第一版（GPT-4o 生成）。代码和数据公开。
papers.abstract_en: Conversational product search lets users find products through a multi-turn dialogue instead of a single keyword query, but Persian lacks the large conversational datasets needed to train and evaluate such systems; existing Persian e-commerce dialogue resources cover few categories and small catalogs. We present a framework that builds such a dataset automatically from a real e-commerce catalog and release the resulting dataset. The framework crawls 12,926 products in seven categories of the Digikala marketplace, groups them into 170 semantically coherent clusters, and selects the question the assistant asks at every turn with the Regularized Partition Balance (RPB) score. The RPB score accounts for feature coverage, the probability that the user can answer and the number of values, and generalizes entropy-based question selection. An LLM then verbalizes each question plan into a natural Persian dialogue. In a simulation on the full catalog, the RPB score needs 0.11 fewer turns than the strongest entropy baseline when the difficulty of answering differs between features, and is practically equivalent to it when it does not. Using only a free LLM API, we generated 1,000 requirement-driven dialogues covering all 170 clusters, with turn-level feature annotations; automatic checks and an LLM judge confirm their consistency with the catalog, while their realism is lower than that of the first, GPT-4o-generated version. Code and data are publicly available.

papers.title: GERF: A Token-Efficient Multimodal Retrieval Framework for Schema-Guided Scientific Information Extraction
papers.title_zh: GERF:面向 Schema 引导科学信息抽取的省 token 多模态检索框架
papers.summary_zh: 用异构证据图检索字段相关的文本与图表,输入 token 比全文处理少 73.4%。
papers.abstract_zh: 科学信息抽取(IE)是 AI for Science 的基础环节,把科学文献中的实验知识转为结构化、可追溯的数据。但关键实验细节分散在正文、表格、图、图注和上下文讨论中,纯文本抽取难以还原。现有基于 LLM 和多模态 RAG 的流程通常依赖全文上下文或粗粒度的页面级检索,引入大量无关证据,文本与视觉 token 开销都很高。我们提出 GERF,一个用于省 token、Schema 引导多模态科学 IE 的==基于图的证据检索框架==。GERF 把每篇文章表示成异构证据图,通过语义和结构关系连接 schema 字段、文本块、图及图中衍生内容。以 schema 字段作为检索锚点,GERF 结合直接语义检索、带重启随机游走(Random Walk with Restart)和感知空值的证据扩展,构造紧凑的、字段级的多模态证据包。视觉解析只作用于图选出的图片,避免对整篇文档做无差别处理。我们从证据检索质量和流程级输入 token 消耗两个角度评估。在专家标注的 SOFC-Exp 语料上,GERF 为 **94.55%** 的待评字段实例检索到了有标注支撑的证据,为下游抽取提供了较广的字段级证据覆盖。在 token 对比中,GERF 相比全文处理平均减少 **73.40%** 的输入 token,且比所评测的页面级流程用得更少。
papers.abstract_en: Scientific information extraction (IE) is a fundamental component of AI for Science, transforming experimental knowledge embedded in scientific literature into structured and traceable data for evidence synthesis, scientific database construction, and data-driven discovery. However, critical experimental details are often distributed across text, tables, figures, captions, and surrounding discussion, making them difficult to recover using conventional text-only extraction. Existing LLM-based and multimodal RAG pipelines typically rely on full-document context or coarse page-level retrieval, introducing substantial irrelevant evidence and high textual and visual token costs. We propose GERF, a Graph-based Evidence Retrieval Framework for token-efficient, schema-guided multimodal scientific IE. GERF represents each article as a heterogeneous evidence graph that connects schema fields, text chunks, figures, and figure-derived content through semantic and structural relations. Using schema fields as retrieval anchors, GERF combines direct semantic retrieval, Random Walk with Restart, and null-aware evidence expansion to construct compact, field-specific multimodal evidence packages. Visual interpretation is applied only to graph-selected figures, avoiding indiscriminate processing of the entire document. We evaluate GERF from two complementary perspectives: evidence retrieval quality and pipeline-level input-token consumption. On the expert-annotated SOFC-Exp corpus, GERF retrieves gold-supported evidence for 94.55% of the evaluated field instances, providing broad field-level evidence coverage for downstream extraction. In the token comparison, GERF reduces average input-token usage by 73.40% relative to full-context processing and uses fewer tokens than the evaluated page-level pipelines.

papers.title: DKnown-Jev-2: Article-Level Answer-Evidence Classification and Efficient Inference with a Pre-trained Language Model
papers.title_zh: DKnown-Jev-2：基于预训练语言模型的文章级答案证据分类与高效推理
papers.summary_zh: 跨段落联合编码的文章级答案证据分类器，一次前向同时判断 AE 与 NE，准确率 91.77%。
papers.abstract_zh: 规范性知识问答中的证据选择，需要判断候选文章是否包含在问题所适用条件下直接支持答案的内容。我们提出 DKnown-Jev-2，一个面向跨多段落证据整合的==文章级答案证据分类器==。该模型联合编码问题条件、文章元数据和段落内容，并用 pointer 式分类头在一次前向中预测答案证据（AE）和非答案证据（NE）。在人工标注的 972 个评测实例上，DKnown-Jev-2 达到 **91.77% 准确率和 91.28% macro-F1**，分别比 Jev 高 2.16 和 2.37 个百分点，同时减少了证据漏检和非证据误报。测试集包含 317 个多段落实例，正文最长 9,322 字符。共享的文章编码和非自回归分类支持低延迟推理。这些结果表明所提方法对规范性知识问答中的文章级证据选择是有效的。
papers.abstract_en: Evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering requires determining whether a candidate article contains content that directly supports an answer under the applicable conditions of the question. We present DKnown-Jev-2, an article-level answer evidence classifier designed for evidence integration across multiple paragraphs. The model jointly encodes question conditions, article metadata, and paragraph content, and uses a pointer-style classification head to predict Answer Evidence (AE) and Non-answer Evidence (NE) in a single forward pass. Ona manually annotated test set of 972 evaluation instances, DKnown-Jev-2 achieves 91.77% accuracy and 91.28% macro-F1, outperforming Jev by 2.16 and 2.37 percentage points, respectively, while reducing both evidence misses and non-evidence false positives. The test set contains 317 multi-paragraph instances, with a maximum body length of 9,322 characters. Shared article encoding and non-autoregressive classification support low-latency inference. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method for article-level evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering.

papers.title: Why Calibrated BM25 Filtering Barely Reduced Context on LongMemEval
papers.title_zh: 为什么校准后的 BM25 过滤在 LongMemEval 上几乎没有减少上下文
papers.summary_zh: 在 LongMemEval 上 BM25 过滤仅节省 0.096% 输入 token，并给出打包过滤的精确检验。
papers.abstract_zh: 当助手对旧对话做摘要后，可能还需要原始对话中的某个细节。它可以对归档段落按问题打分，但只有能放进 prompt 的段落才会到达回答模型。我们检验了在考虑这一长度限制后，BM25 过滤器是否真的节省输入 token。过滤器是在那些单独就能纠正模型仅凭摘要答错的答案的段落上校准的。在 75 个 LongMemEval 问题上，==过滤只改变了一个 prompt，仅节省 0.096% 的输入 token==。无论有无过滤器，模型在第二套自动评分下答对的是同一批问题。在随机样本上，两位人工评分者商定的判断与自动评分在明确可比的情况下一致率为 92.9%（Cohen's kappa = 0.805）。基于此前区分“检索到的证据”与“送达的证据”的工作，我们给出一个针对“按固定顺序尝试整段、放不下就跳过”的打包器的精确检验：**不用过滤器运行打包器；当且仅当某个被收入的段落得分低于阈值时，prompt 才会改变**。代码与数据：https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/Certfold
papers.abstract_en: An assistant that summarizes old conversations may later need a detail from the original exchange. It can score archived passages against the question, but only passages that fit in the prompt reach the answering model. We tested whether a BM25 filter saves input tokens once that limit is taken into account. We calibrated the filter on passages that individually corrected an answer the model got wrong from the summaries alone. Across 75 LongMemEval questions, filtering changed one prompt and saved 0.096% of input tokens. With and without the filter, the model answered the same questions correctly under a second automated grading. On a random sample, two human graders' settled judgments agreed with the automated grades in 92.9% of definite comparisons (Cohen's kappa = 0.805). Building on earlier work that distinguishes retrieved evidence from delivered evidence, we give an exact test for packers that try whole passages in a fixed order and skip any that do not fit. Run the packer without the filter. The prompt changes exactly when an admitted passage scores below the cutoff. Code and data: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/Certfold
